title: MY SQL Database Engineer
description:
MY SQL Database Engineer
6-8 yrs
PAN INDIA Role: Senior Database Engineer About the Job We are looking for a hands-on Senior Database Engineer with strong experience in large-scale SQL-based data transformation and database performance optimisation. The role will focus primarily on developing and maintaining native database transformations that convert data from multiple legacy source models into canonical data models used by cloud-based applications and microservices. The successful candidate will work with large data volumes and will be expected to design scalable SQL transformations, stored procedures, functions, and views, while ensuring that database performance remains efficient as data volumes grow. This role involves working closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and other engineering teams, so strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are important. About You You will have a strong background in hands-on database engineering and complex data transformation, ideally within AWS environments using PostgreSQL and/or MySQL. You should be comfortable taking a legacy data model and designing the SQL transformation required to map it into a new canonical model across multiple tables. You will also have strong database performance engineering skills and be comfortable analysing execution plans, identifying performance bottlenecks, designing appropriate indexing and partitioning strategies, and refactoring poorly performing SQL and database routines. This is a database engineering and development role rather than a traditional DBA. Key Skills & Experience Database Transformation & Development Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, ideally Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Aurora MySQL. Expert-level SQL development skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, functions, and views. Proven experience developing complex native SQL transformations across multiple tables and data models. Experience transforming data from legacy source models into canonical or target data models. Proven experience designing database transformations capable of efficiently processing many millions of records. Strong understanding of set-based processing and designing scalable database logic for large data volumes. Experience designing and implementing scalable, high-performance relational database solutions. Strong understanding of relational data modelling and database design principles. Performance Engineering Strong hands-on experience with database performance tuning and optimisation. Expert knowledge of analysing SQL execution plans and identifying performance bottlenecks. Proven experience refactoring and optimising poorly performing queries, stored procedures and database transformations. Strong understanding of indexing strategies, including the ability to select and implement appropriate indexes based on query and data access patterns. Experience implementing partitioning strategies for large datasets. Ability to diagnose database performance issues and identify root causes across complex SQL workloads. Engineering & Delivery Experience using Git/GitHub or similar version control for database code and schema changes. Experience working with CI/CD processes for database deployments. Ability to work independently on complex technical problems while collaborating effectively with architects and other engineering teams. Experience working within Agile delivery teams using tools such as Jira. Secondary Skills - Nice to Have Experience with AWS services such as Database Migration Service (DMS), and DynamoDB. Understanding Change Data Capture (CDC) and database replication patterns. Exposure to Azure technologies such as Azure Data Factory and Azure SQL Managed Instance. Experience developing scripts or automation to support database engineering and deployment activities. Experience with automated database testing. Experience working across both AWS and Azure environments. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

 About the Role We are looking for a Senior SQL Server DBA to take ownership of a large, complex on-premise SQL Server estate for an enterprise client. This is a hands-on, production-facing role weighted toward server migration and platform support, alongside day-to-day operational ownership not a monitoring-only position. The estate comprises multiple clustered SQL Server instances, including a production environment distributed across three servers with a separate disaster recovery setup and a one-to-one development clone. It carries 400+ SSIS jobs, 35+ SSAS cubes and extensive SSRS usage, feeding a large downstream reporting community. You will be the person accountable for keeping this estate healthy, resolving the issues it produces, and moving it safely. 
 Key Responsibilities Migration & Modernisation Plan and execute SQL Server migrations across multi-server and clustered topologies, covering assessment, inventory, cutover and hypercare Own the full migration checkpoint set — logins with SIDs , SSISDB and its master key, SSRS encryption keys, Agent jobs, proxies, linked servers, SSAS cubes and downstream connection dependencies Design parallel-run and reconciliation approaches, define rollback criteria in advance, and validate post-migration performance against pre-migration baselines Handle legacy artefacts where original owners, credentials and documentation are no longer available 
 Daily Server Health Check & Maintenance Perform structured daily health checks across all instances: service and Agent status, database state, failed and long-running jobs, backup success, free space across data, log, tempdb and backup volumes, blocking sessions and error log review Monitor job duration against normal bands and investigate anomalies before they become failures Verify downstream data currency for priority reporting assets, including detection of jobs that succeed while loading stale or partial data Own scheduled maintenance: threshold-driven index and statistics maintenance within agreed windows, integrity checks, msdb and SSISDB history cleanup, and log file management Produce and circulate a daily health summary, and progressively automate routine checks into a single consolidated report Track capacity and growth trends — file growth, drive consumption and batch window drift — and forecast constraints ahead of impact 
 Access Management & User Support Manage the access request queue end to end across the database engine, SSAS cubes and SSRS — grant, modify and revoke within agreed SLAs Administer permissions through Active Directory groups rather than individual logins, maintaining an accurate access register Resolve access-related incidents: login failures, orphaned users after restores, permission escalation requests, service account and credential expiry, and job owner validation errors Maintain a central service account register covering owner, expiry date and dependent objects, with proactive expiry alerting Conduct periodic permission audits, remove leavers and privilege creep, and respond to audit and compliance queries on who has access to what Act as first point of contact for user-reported database and reporting access issues, with clear communication and turnaround 
 Database Administration Own backup and recovery: strategy design, verification, corruption handling and periodic timed restore drills against agreed RTO and RPO Manage instance configuration, index and statistics strategy, integrity checks and capacity planning Diagnose and resolve production incidents — blocking chains, transaction log exhaustion, tempdb contention, storage latency and query regression Establish monitoring baselines and alerting where none currently exist 
 Platform Services — SSIS, SSAS, SSRS Administer and support Integration, Analysis and Reporting Services: deployment, configuration, security, cube processing and subscription management Manage the SQL Server Agent job estate — ownership standards, proxy accounts, scheduling, dependency chains and failure triage 
 High Availability & Disaster Recovery Maintain and test clustering and DR configurations, including scheduled failover testing Own the DR runbook and document explicitly what falls outside high-availability coverage Change & Infrastructure Coordination Represent the database platform during Windows patching and infrastructure change windows — pre-checks, controlled service sequencing, post-change validation and pipeline catch-up Work with infrastructure, OS, storage and Active Directory teams, and escalate to vendor support with a supporting evidence pack Stakeholder Engagement Communicate incident status and business impact in plain language, on a predictable cadence Author root cause analyses and maintain runbooks, access registers and platform documentation 
 Required Skills & Experience Essential 6+ years administering production SQL Server, with demonstrable ownership rather than shared support Proven end-to-end server migration experience on a multi-database estate, with specific examples Strong backup and recovery capability — restore sequencing, corruption diagnosis, DBCC CHECKDB , RESTORE VERIFYONLY , and experience of real recovery scenarios Established daily operational discipline — able to describe their own health check routine and what they automated Practical experience resolving access issues across all three security models: engine logins and database roles, SSAS role-based cube security, and SSRS item-level permissions Understanding of orphaned users, SID mismatches and service account lifecycle management Hands-on SSIS administration: deployment models, SSISDB, protection levels, parameterisation and job troubleshooting Working knowledge of SSAS (including cube security and processing) and SSRS (including encryption keys and subscriptions) Performance diagnosis using wait statistics and DMVs — able to distinguish platform-bound from code-bound problems Clustering and/or Always On experience, including having performed a real failover Experience coordinating with infrastructure teams through patching and change windows Clear written and verbal communication in a client-facing setting Desirable Multi-source ETL integration experience across cloud storage, relational and SaaS sources SAP-sourced data warehouse exposure PostgreSQL or other non-SQL Server platform familiarity Partitioning strategy and large-table retention management Monitoring tooling and baseline instrumentation Experience implementing group managed service accounts (gMSAs) or automated credential rotation Microsoft certification — Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent 
 What Will Set a Candidate Apart Has migrated an estate where the original developers had left and the documentation did not exist Can describe a production incident they diagnosed against resistance, and how they built the evidence Has replaced a manual morning routine with an automated health report, and can explain what they chose to alert on and why Treats monitoring baselines as a prerequisite rather than a nice-to-have Knows what a high-availability configuration does not protect

 Project Monitoring: - Monitor day-to-day progress of all ongoing civil works. - Track project progress against approved schedules and targets. - Prepare Daily Progress Reports (DPR), Weekly Progress Reports (WPR), and Monthly Progress Reports (MPR). - Monitor manpower, machinery, and material deployment. - Ensure optimum utilization of available resources. - Identify bottlenecks and provide practical solutions to maintain project timelines. 
 Site Coordination: - Visit project sites regularly and monitor actual progress. - Coordinate with Site Engineers, Project Managers, contractors, consultants, and clients. - Resolve execution issues through effective planning and communication. - Ensure timely availability of approved drawings, materials, machinery, and workforce. - Provide planning and execution guidance to Site Engineers and project teams. 
 Execution Monitoring: Monitor and coordinate all types of civil construction activities, including: - Road construction Flexible & Rigid Pavement - Earthwork and embankment - Buildings and industrial structures - RCC and structural works - Drainage and sewerage works - Water supply and pipeline works - Boundary walls and compound development - Landscaping and site development - Miscellaneous infrastructure works 
 Government Project Experience Mandatory / Preferred: - Candidates with experience working on government construction projects will be strongly preferred. - Experience dealing directly with West Bengal Government Departments, PWD, CPWD, WBSEDCL, WBPHED, Irrigation & Waterways, Urban Development & Municipal Affairs, Rural Development, or other government agencies will be an added advantage. - Should have a good understanding of government project procedures, departmental specifications, tender conditions, BOQ, measurement and billing procedures, work orders, approvals, inspections, and project documentation. - Experience coordinating with Departmental Engineers, Government Authorities, Consultants, and other statutory agencies. - Should be familiar with government contract administration, progress monitoring, extension of time (EOT), delay analysis, recovery planning, and resolution of site-related issues. - Preference will be given to candidates having substantial experience in West Bengal Government projects and knowledge of West Bengal PWD / relevant departmental specifications and procedures. 
 Quality & Safety: - Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and contract requirements. - Coordinate with the Quality Control team for inspections and testing. - Ensure compliance with applicable safety regulations and company HSE policies. - Monitor quality-related observations and ensure timely corrective action.  Coordination: - Coordinate with Procurement for timely availability of materials. - Coordinate with Design, Planning, Accounts, and Project teams. - Participate in project review meetings with management, clients, consultants, and government authorities. - Escalate critical project issues to management along with practical recommendations and recovery measures.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data & AI
description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game\-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses
   

  

* Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.


 Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data\-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first\-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !
   

  

 WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
   

  

 The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world\-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.
   

  

 We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non\-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world\-class team using best\-in\-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.
* Full\-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way.
* AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non\-technical stakeholders.
* Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact.
* Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non\-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date.
* AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours.
* Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time.
* Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 3 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you’ve already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You’re imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems.
* Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy\-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless.
* Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.


 As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre\-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
   

  

 Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.
   

  

 Love this job and want to apply?
   

  

 Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
   

  

 Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
   

  

 Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
   

  

 WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

description: Key responsibilities Profile and map the Co\-Pilot data model to Navigator field by field; agree profiling and cleansing rules with the data owners. Build the ETL once as a reusable, version\-controlled pipeline, then execute it in waves. Run three to four incremental trial loads at production scale in pre\-production, each bigger and closer to the real thing. Reconcile every load record counts, financial and compliance spot checks and carry a named business sign\-off per data set. Scope the pipeline to whichever archive option Whitbread chooses: foundation and seed data only for a read\-only archive; plus transaction history if history is migrated into Navigator; or a one\-way transfer to low\-cost storage. Execute the final delta load at cutover from the rehearsed runbook. Essential skills and experience Three\-Six years or more data\-engineering migration, with strong ETL design and SQL, ideally on Azure Data services. Demonstrable production\-scale migration experience, including trial loads, reconciliation and business sign\-off. Comfort with both relational and document targets and with data cleansing and mapping from a messy source. Discipline around evidence: reconciliation packs, not assurances. Desirable Migration off Nintex K2 or a comparable low\-code platform. Experience of compliance records\-retention data for example accident and RIDDOR records.

**Key Responsibilities**
**System Configuration \& Administration:**
* Configure and maintain the web\-based material data management platform, including user workflows, templates, forms, user roles, and system settings.

* Document Extraction: Demonstrated experience extracting and preparing data from Excel, Word, PDF, and technical documents.
* Technical Skills: Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, and database concepts.
* System Support: Experience supporting web\-based enterprise applications, technical data systems, or document management platforms, including low\-code/no\-code configurations.
* Vendor \& User Support: Background working with software vendors or technical support teams to resolve application bugs and system issues.
* Domain Exposure (Preferred): Familiarity with material properties, product datasheets, testing standards, or engineering documentation is a strong plus

 Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

* Support testing, UAT, deployment, cutover, and go\-live activities.
* Ensure technical solutions follow SAP Clean Core principles.

* 7–10\+ years of SAP experience, with at least 3–5 years of hands\-on SAP MDG technical experience.
* Strong technical expertise in SAP MDG Business Partner.
* Strong understanding of Customer, Supplier, and Business Partner data structures.
* Hands\-on experience with MDG data models, workflows, BRF\+, validations, derivations, UI configuration, and replication.

* Invest in Your Learning: Access annual training budget for professional development.

 The Senior Support Engineer, ERP role is a cornerstone within our organization, focused on delivering exceptional technical support for QAD and Progress products. title: Head of AI and Data
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
 
  





 Takachar is focused on transforming loose, wet, and bulky crop and forest residues into valuable, carbon\-negative bioproducts for rural communities. By deploying small\-scale, low\-cost, portable systems on tractors and pickup trucks, Takachar upgrades biomass on\-site into products such as fertilizer blends, biofuels, and chemicals without external energy inputs. This approach reduces open\-air burning, mitigates air pollution and wildfire risk, and supports environmental justice. Takachar’s mission is to enable self\-sufficient rural communities that are less dependent on unstable global supply chains for essential chemical commodities. In doing so, the company helps create localized jobs and sustainable economic opportunities in hard\-to\-access regions.
 



  




**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

  





 We run a fleet of distributed pyrolysis reactors that turn agricultural and forestry residue into biochar, and we convert that into verified carbon removal credits. Every credit we issue rests on a chain of evidence that starts at a sensor on a reactor in a village and ends in a monitoring report an auditor signs off on. This role owns that entire chain.
 



  





 You will own three areas: the data and telemetry platform, the AI and analytics work that sits on top of it, and the carbon credits function that turns it all into issued credits. You will also help our clients do the same for their own projects. The bet behind this role is that these three things are actually one problem, and that whoever holds all of it can build a data\-informed software service that is faster, cheaper, and more powerful than anyone else in biochar.
 



  





 This is a leadership role with a junior data scientist under it — and it is a hands\-on role. You will write code, read methodologies line by line, and sit in audit calls. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job.
 



  




**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
**1\. Data \& Telemetry Platform** 

 •    Own the end\-to\-end data infrastructure: from IoT telemetry on distributed reactors, field apps, forms, lab reports and APIs, through ingestion and processing, to analytics and reporting.
 



 •    Design and operate cloud\-based infrastructure for IoT telemetry, real\-time data processing, warehousing, and operational dashboards serving field teams and partners.
 



 •    Make the system
 **auditable by construction** 
 : transparent, reproducible, tamper\-evident data trails that hold up to third\-party verification, not audit trails bolted on afterwards.
 



 •    Own data governance, integrity, security and access control, including multi\-tenant access where customers see only their own sites.
 



 •    Keep it usable for the people who actually feed it — field operators, plant staff, farmers and partners with varying technical comfort.
   




**2\. AI, Analytics \& Reactor Optimization** 

 •    Build the analytics layer that turns raw reactor telemetry into operational insight: yield, conversion efficiency, process stability, anomaly and fault detection, downtime drivers.
 



 •    Apply ML and AI to reactor optimization — process parameter tuning, soft sensors, predictive maintenance, guiding operators toward better runs.
 



 •    Feed reactor data analysis back into product development, so the next generation of reactors is designed against evidence rather than intuition.
 



 •    Apply AI and automation to accelerate registry compliance workflows — from documentation to verification — with a focus on speed and accuracy over manual processes.
   




**3\. Carbon Credits Digital Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (dMRV)** 

 •    Own dMRV end to end for our projects: monitoring plans, field and lab data collection protocols, monitoring reports, verification audits carried through to issuance.
 



 •    Own compliance and listings across major voluntary carbon standards. Maintain deep knowledge of registry methodologies, submission requirements, and regulatory evolution.
 



 •    Read methodologies closely, build the documentation that satisfies them, submit it, and answer auditor questions directly.
 



 •    Hold the technical line on biochar\-specific MRV: biomass characterization, pyrolysis process monitoring, carbon content quantification, permanence tracking, and the analytical chemistry (elemental, proximate, heavy metals) that underpins it.
 



 •    Stay ahead of methodology revisions, registry rule changes, and Article 6 / voluntary\-market developments, and translate them into changes in how we build and operate.
   




**4\. dMRV Product \& Hardware Innovation** 

 •    Develop scalable MRV protocols and measurement strategies for distributed production assets in remote locations, ensuring rigor and auditability at scale.
 



 •    Build software tooling for MRV — internal and, where it makes sense, customer\-facing.
 



 •    Work with the product team on hardware and instrumentation innovation for measurement: what gets sensed, how it is verified, and how measurement error is bounded and defended.
   




**5\. Client Enablement** 

 •    Act as the senior technical voice in customer conversations alongside business development.
   




**6\. Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Decision\-Making** 

 •    Lead and grow a team spanning MRV operations, data engineering, data analysis and field engineering. Hire, set standards, and raise the technical bar.
 



 •    Sit with product development, business development and operations on decisions that determine what we build, what we can credibly claim, and what we can sell.
 




 •    Translate between worlds fluently: registry rules to engineers, sensor limitations to auditors, technical risk to leadership and buyers.

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
   

  

  

* Maintain compliance with Group Data \& Record Management Standards (GDMS) by setting the agenda and driving the BU/Fn Data Council effectively as per the GDMS, covering various aspect of Data \& Record Management.

* Support delivery of tactical and strategic solution in collaboration with Technology Transformation team, Technology and Controls Business Partner teams.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and identify automation opportunities.
* Driving a consistent approach for Reporting and management of Data \& Records across the business in BaU and due to any impacts arising from changes to RRS / GDMS relevant policies and standards.
* Lead engagement with Chief Data Office and Tech partners.

* Experience in Data Management, Data Governance including records management. Ability to review business processes from data lens and identify critical upstream and downstream components especially in financial services organisation.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality \& Controls, Data Lineage and Reference Data/Metadata Management including relevant policies and frameworks.
* Ability to analyse, interpret and work robustly with stakeholders to to identify data quality issues and develop proposed solutions.
* Excellent problem solving skill sets, think strategically and convey an understanding of big picture to senior management.

* Strong understanding and practical exposure to application of BCBS 239 principles and related frameworks.
* Commercially astute, demonstrates a consultative, yet pragmatic approach with integrity to solving issues, focusing on areas of significance and value to the business.

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Effective communication and presentation skills.
* Experience in Data Management/ Data Governance/ Data Quality Controls, Governance, Reporting and Risk Management preferably in a financial services organisation.
* Proficient in MS Office – PPT, Excel, Word \& Visio.
* Comprehensive understanding of Risk, Governance and Control Frameworks and Processes.
* Understanding of Data Management Principles and Data Governance including BCBS 239\.
* Ability to analyse, interpret and work robustly with others to identify issues and develop proposed solutions.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Noida.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To enable effective data governance, risk management, and compliance within the bank, acting as a liaison between business units and the Data \& Records Management (DRM) function, translating business needs into actionable strategies and ensuring efficient implementation of DRM.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Partnership with the local business unit to ensure successful implementation of data \& records governance frameworks as appropriate to the needs of the business unit.

* Monitoring local data quality and records metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Identification of opportunities for data improvement and optimisation.

title: API Technical Support Executive
description:
**Immediate Joiners Preferred** 




**Company:** 
 Global Financial Datafeeds LLP (GFDL)
 



**Location:** 
 Location: Nashik / Mumbai / Remote
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled
 **API Technical Support Executive** 
 to join our team.
 



 The role involves supporting clients and developers using our
 **REST and WebSocket APIs** 
 , troubleshooting API and connectivity issues, analyzing logs and API responses, assisting with integrations, and working closely with internal Development, Data and Infrastructure teams.
 



 The ideal candidate should have good programming and troubleshooting skills, strong communication abilities, and an interest in
 **API technologies and real\-time financial market data** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. API Technical Support** 



* Provide timely technical support to clients and developers using GFDL APIs.
* Troubleshoot
 **REST API and WebSocket API** 
 issues.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error messages and logs.
* Investigate authentication, connectivity, subscription, data and response\-related issues.
* Reproduce reported issues and identify possible root causes.
* Provide clear technical updates and resolution details to clients.
* Follow up on open issues until successful resolution and client confirmation.



**2\. API Integration Support** 



* Assist clients with integrating GFDL APIs into their applications.
* Understand client\-side API implementation and identify integration issues.
* Provide code snippets and technical examples where required.
* Support API testing using tools such as
 **Postman, Swagger or similar tools** 
 .
* Validate API responses and integration behaviour.
* Prepare and maintain API integration guides and documentation.



**3\. API \& Data Validation** 



* Validate API responses against expected results.
* Investigate discrepancies in market data and API responses.
* Perform functional and regression testing of API features.
* Verify request parameters, response structures and data values.
* Assist in identifying data\-flow or processing\-related issues.



**4\. Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis** 



* Analyze application and server logs to identify the source of issues.
* Investigate API latency, timeout, connection and session\-related problems.
* Perform structured
 **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** 
 .
* Coordinate with Development, Data and Infrastructure teams for complex issues.
* Escalate critical production issues with complete technical information.



**5\. Programming \& Automation** 



* Use programming skills to develop small utilities, scripts and tools for troubleshooting and validation.
* Write scripts for API testing, response validation, log analysis and repetitive support activities.
* Work with languages such as
 **Python, C\#/.NET, JavaScript or Java** 
 .
* Automate repetitive support and validation tasks where appropriate.



**6\. API Performance \& Reliability** 



* Monitor API behaviour and identify potential performance issues.
* Investigate response\-time, connectivity and scalability\-related problems.
* Assist development teams in identifying performance bottlenecks.
* Follow API security, reliability and data\-handling best practices.



**7\. Client Communication** 



* Communicate professionally with clients through support channels.
* Understand and document client requirements and technical problems.
* Collect required information such as API requests, responses, symbols, timestamps and logs.
* Provide clear troubleshooting instructions and resolution updates.
* Gather client feedback and communicate recurring issues internally.



**8\. Documentation** 



* Create and maintain API troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain FAQs, integration documentation and technical knowledge bases.
* Document known issues, resolutions and common troubleshooting procedures.


- 


**Required Skills** 



* Bachelor's degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **REST APIs and WebSocket APIs** 
 .
* Knowledge of
 **HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, XML and API authentication** 
 .
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with API testing tools such as
 **Postman / Swagger** 
 .
* Programming knowledge in at least one of:
* Python
* C\# / .NET
* JavaScript
* Java
* Basic\-to\-good knowledge of
 **SQL and databases** 
 .
* Ability to read and analyze application/server logs.
* Good understanding of networking concepts such as:
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Ports
* SSL/TLS
* VPN
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving ability.


- 


**Good to Have** 



* Experience in
 **API Technical Support / Application Support / Integration Support** 
 .
* Experience supporting production APIs.
* Knowledge of real\-time or streaming data systems.
* Knowledge of
 **financial market data / stock market APIs** 
 .
* Experience with Windows and Linux environments.
* Experience with API monitoring or API management platforms.
* Knowledge of performance testing and API automation.
* Experience handling client\-facing technical support.


- 


**What We Offer** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 **real\-time financial market data** 
 .
* Exposure to REST and WebSocket API technologies.
* Experience with production\-level technical troubleshooting.
* Opportunity to work with Development, Data and Infrastructure teams.
* Opportunity to build expertise in
 **API Support, Integration and Automation** 
 .
* Career growth in API and financial technology.


- 


**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a technical issue from:
 



**Client Issue → Reproduce → Analyze → Troubleshoot → Root Cause → Coordinate → Resolve → Validate** 




 Candidates who are technically curious, willing to learn and interested in
 **APIs, programming, troubleshooting and financial technology** 
 are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**How to Apply**

title: Data Platforms Operations Expert
description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
   

  

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
 We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
   

  

**Purpose And Scope**
 The Data Operations Specialist is responsible for implementing practical and efficient ways to organize and process data, to enable measurement, analytics and reporting that will be used to develop actionable insight for inclusion in reports that communicate the value of Data Strategy activities. In this role, you are to build and cultivate trusted partnerships with groups from various areas of the company (within Data Strategy and outside such as with Omnichannel Strategy \& Operations, Information Systems (DX), Finance, Legal, Ethics \& Compliance, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your focus is enforcing data standards. Your pivotal responsibility lies in fostering effective collaboration, communication, and strategic alignment with the mentioned groups to propel the Data Strategy practice forward in the quality and efficiency of their analytics and reporting. This role operates within the Customer Engagement Excellence (CEE) group, which supports capabilities across VALUE Delivery, including Commercial (Sales/Marketing), Market Access and Medical Affairs, whilst prioritizing ethical decision making. During all such activities, there is a need to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs capabilities is not compromised. You are expected to proactively communicate and consult with your Chapter and Value Team Leads as necessary to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs is maintained at all times.
   

  

 This is a global role that is also expected to build trusted partnerships with global, regional, and affiliate groups from various areas of the company (with co\-colleagues within Value Delivery and outside such as Information Systems (DX), Brand teams, Procurement, HR, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your strategic mindset and commitment to modern data technologies will be key in shaping our data landscape.
   

  

 The Chapter Member receives capability and skillset development under the guidance of the Chapter Lead, who provides coaching and mentoring within the Agile model.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
* Data Sourcing \& Acquisition:
* Work closely with Business to understand data needs, assess and prioritize new data use cases, and ensure Analytics Data Layer supports business reporting and measurable outcomes.
* Conduct due diligence to validate data quality, reliability, and alignment with business objectives.
* Serve as an SME for data pipeline (including ADL, Databricks, and legacy data management) and technical SME for dashboards which consume data.
* Identify and implement opportunities for efficiency gains in data workflows, processes, and systems.
* Continuously evaluate tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve data operations efficiency and scalability.
* Data Onboarding:
* Ensure data is properly formatted, validated, and transformed for marketing analytics and reporting, holding external vendors accountable for data accuracy and timeliness.
* Establish data validation frameworks to assess the completeness, timeliness, and accuracy of onboarded datasets, implementing monitoring mechanisms to detect and resolve integration issues proactively.
* Partner with IT teams to ensure smooth integration of new data sources into the organization's data infrastructure.
* Clean, standardize, and transform data to align with marketing and analytical requirements.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data dictionaries and metadata documentation.
* Data Management \& Governance:
* Define, implement, and ensure adherence to data standards for structure, consistency, and interoperability across systems and teams.
* Oversee the storage, organization, and accessibility of promotional marketing data ensuring compliance with internal governance standards.
* Develop and enforce data quality standards to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Partner with stakeholders to create standardized data taxonomies and classification frameworks to improve usability.
* Partner with stakeholders to transform ingested data into analytic ready formats.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data issues, implementing corrective measures when necessary, communicating data\-related issues and resolutions to stakeholders.
* Provide strategic guidance on data source quality, context and usage based on business needs and analytical use cases.
* Coordinate and facilitate data source changes and communication to necessary business stakeholders.
* Assist the Data Foundation Pod in triaging new projects to determine appropriate ownership and/or engagement from the Value Teams within and outside of the Data Foundation Pod, necessary Capability teams, and potentially other Hub groups.
* Champion the adoption of Agile methodology in both project delivery and continuous integrations and continuous delivery (CI/CD) of efficient and scalable data management, reporting, and analytics solutions.
* Medical Affairs Enablement:
* Contribute to the expansion of Medical Affairs systems and solutions which may include Clinical Trial Management (CTMS), external funding and grants, Vault Medical content management system, and medical incident reporting functions.
* Ensure that data operations supporting Medical Affairs preserve the integrity and independence of the function, applying appropriate governance, access controls, and privacy safeguards when onboarding and managing medical, clinical, and R\&D data sources.
* Reporting \& Automation:
* Provide regular updates on data availability, integrity, and performance to key stakeholders.
* Maintain a schedule for data delivery and loading.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process automation to enhance operational efficiency.
* Stay informed on emerging industry trends and advancements in marketing data and data management, advising leadership on innovative solutions that complement and drive business growth.
* Agile:
* Utilize agile approaches, collaborate in agile ceremonies and Ways of Working to ensure effective delivery for the business
* Collaborate and foster a culture of collaboration, flexibility, and responsiveness to change, enabling the team to thrive in an agile environment


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field.
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in data management, with a focus on digital marketing datasets
* Experience in sourcing, onboarding, and managing large datasets from external vendors.
* Proficiency with a coding language (e.g. SQL, Python), MS Excel and PowerPoint, ETL/data processing tools.
* Exposure to and/or good understanding of Data Warehousing/Data Lakehouse platforms and technologies (e.g., AWS S3/RedShift, SQL, etc.)
* Good understanding of data stewardship and governance concepts (e.g., data ingestion, reference data management, data transformations, data quality and observability, data archiving, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to understand business requirements as well as underlying infrastructure applications, systems, and processes. Proven experience in process mapping, process improvement, and problem\-solving skills with demonstrated ability in taking initiative to proactively evaluate existing strategies and processes and recommend best\-fit solutions when appropriate.
* Deep understanding of marketing data types (campaign data, engagement metrics, media spend) and their applications.
* Familiarity with marketing tech platforms like CM360, SA360, Meta.
* Experience working with Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven ability to align data initiatives with business objectives, ensuring data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent organizational, project planning and business change management skills with a strong attention to detail and ability to effectively manage cross\-functional projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills to effectively interact to a diverse audience.
* Extensive computer proficiency in other Microsoft products: Excel, VBA, Macros, Access, Visio, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, etc.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s Degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field
* Understanding of Data models for platforms like CM360
* Pharmaceutical industry experience
* Experience working with Databricks
* Strong understanding of data architecture, engineering, operations, and reporting within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry across Commercial, Medical (R\&D), and Finance domains.
* Familiarity with Medical Affairs data sources and systems (e.g., CTMS, Vault Medical, medical incident reporting) and with secondary data sources commonly used in Life Sciences (e.g., script level, patient longitudinal, promotional, omnichannel data).
* Experience supporting the US market (preferred but not required).


**Work Environment**
 This position is based in our Global Capability Center in India. At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.
   

  

**What Awaits You At Astellas**
* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real\-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.

**Position Summary** 




 The MDM Lead will lead the execution, oversight, and continuous improvement of global master data operations from the India GCC. * Define and enforce data standards, stewardship practices, controls, approval paths, and documentation requirements.

* Coordinate with compliance, audit, risk, privacy, and security stakeholders on data controls and evidence requirements.
* Improve MDM platforms, workflows, reporting, and integration processes; support ETL and data\-quality automation.
* Maintain domain definitions, data dictionaries, SOPs, issue logs, root\-cause analysis, and governance reporting.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in information systems, business administration, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
* At least 5 years of master data management or data governance experience, including 1 to 2 years in a lead or team\-lead capacity.
* Strong understanding of MDM principles, lifecycle controls, stewardship, data quality, governance, and enterprise data structures.
* Experience with ERP master data, preferably Oracle Fusion, across Finance, Supply Chain, customer, supplier, item, or location domains.
* Strong SQL, Excel, reporting, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading testing, validation, issue resolution, and process improvement across multiple systems.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with Informatica MDM, SAP MDG, IBM InfoSphere, or a comparable enterprise MDM platform.
* Experience with Power BI, Looker, data integration tools, cloud data platforms, or data lakes.

* CDMP, CIMP, data governance, or related professional certification.
* Experience in a GCC, shared services, or global delivery environment.



**Core Competencies and Characteristics** 



* Balances strategic governance with hands\-on operational ownership.
* Uses data and service metrics to improve quality, turnaround, controls, and stakeholder confidence.
* Demonstrates a hands\-on, high\-ownership mindset with strong organization, follow\-through, and execution.
* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Works effectively through ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving processes.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented work within agreed timelines.
* Builds repeatable workflows, knowledge assets, and practical process improvements.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

description:
Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and unit test custom SAP Data Services (BODS) jobs, dataflows, and complex mappings according to technical standards.

 **BODS** 
 and

**3\. Data Quality \& Performance Optimization**

**4\. Project Support \& Cutover**

description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744229
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator


**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.

  



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**

  



Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.

  



The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.

  



This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.

  


**Your key responsibilities**

  


* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**

  


* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  


* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.

  


**Technical skills to include:**

  


* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  


* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.

  


**What we look for**

  


* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.

  


**What we offer**

  



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

  


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
