As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and support Salesforce solutions across product modeling, pricing, quoting, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Configure and enhance CPQ capabilities including product rules, price rules, bundles, product options, quote templates, discounting, and approval workflows
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and deliver scalable business solutions
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and platform APIs to support related processes
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, contract, and other enterprise platforms
* Participate in technical design, story grooming, sprint planning, testing, code reviews, release management, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across CPQ configuration, pricing logic, automation, integrations, and system performance
* Support documentation, UAT, regression testing, and user enablement to improve adoption and platform reliability
* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery: Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ, utilizing a mix of declarative configuration and custom development (Apex, LWC, and Flow)
* System Architecture: Design and implement robust integrations between CPQ and downstream systems (ERP, Billing, Telemetry) to ensure data integrity across the Lead\-to\-Cash lifecycle
* Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards for code quality by implementing testable, modular solutions and contributing to shared frameworks and CI/CD best practices
* Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing CPQ flows, improving calculator speed and user experience for a global sales force
* Mentorship \& Influence: Lead peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical playbook, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering organization


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform
* Good understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, sales workflows, and Salesforce best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs
* Experience with product modeling, pricing rules, quoting workflows, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, or other enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, version control, and Salesforce release practices
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, develop, and troubleshoot automation jobs for complex workflows across AWS accounts and regions.
* Create and assign Jira tasks to drive progress with clear ownership and follow‑through.
* Create and maintain wiki documentation / README files for workflows, procedures, and tooling enhancements.
* Identify gaps in runbook coverage and author new runbooks that enable repeatable, reliable operations.
* Display mastery of service(s) within a single pillar (e.g., Networking, Compute, Storage, Security, Orchestration).
* Demonstrate competency across multiple pillars, understanding how services interact end‑to‑end.
* Collaborate effectively across CloudOps, SRE, Security, Product Engineering, and other technology teams.


**Cvent Behavioral Competencies**
* Anticipates customer needs and delivers services beyond expectations, with a strong internal customer mindset.
* Uses customer insights and data to influence and guide new infrastructure and automation offerings.
* Serves as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain long‑term, sustainable, and profitable relationships.


**CloudOps Core Competencies**
* Troubleshoot high‑complexity issues, including multi‑service and multi‑region incidents.
* Coordinate and troubleshoot issues involving 3rd‑party vendors, assisting in vendor relationship management.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior engineers on troubleshooting, design, and best practices.
* Share knowledge broadly (e.g., lunch‑and‑learns, mentoring, internal training, documentation).
* Perform as an individual contributor on high‑complexity tasks, owning them end‑to‑end.
* Act as primary point of contact for internal and cross‑tech (CTC) level projects in your domain.
* Help allocate work across individual contributors and identify when additional support is needed.
* Recognize when project timelines are at risk and partner with leadership to adjust scope or approach.
* Communicates progress, risks, and needs clearly to management and stakeholders.
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and respectful organizational culture.


 If you’re passionate about
 **Cloud Infrastructure** 
 , enjoy
 **building automation and tools** 
 , and are excited about applying
 **AI agents and orchestration to real‑world infrastructure problems** 
 , we’d love to talk to you.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Role: Solution Architect – Semantic Governance AI Platform
   

 Engagement: Project / Contract / Strategic Collaboration
   

 Experience: 8\+ years preferred
   

 Domain: Enterprise Data Governance \| AI/ML \| Semantic Architecture \| Knowledge Graphs
   

 Location: Remote / Hybrid
   

  

 About the Project
   

  

 We are building an enterprise Semantic Governance AI Platform that establishes authoritative business definitions, manages semantic conflicts, maintains regulatory and decision provenance, and ensures approved definitions are consistently implemented across data warehouses, BI platforms, ML systems and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The platform will integrate with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Collibra/Alation and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can own the end\-to\-end technical architecture and work closely with business stakeholders, Data Governance teams, Data Scientists, Data Engineers and development teams.
   

  

 The architect will translate business governance requirements into a scalable architecture covering semantic modeling, workflow, AI, knowledge graphs, integrations, security, APIs and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

description:
Job Summary 
 Application Reliability Engineer. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Payments and Financial Engineering builds the systems that power Apple's Finance and Accounting capabilities, processing very high-volume micro-transactions across Apple Pay, App Store, iTunes, Retail, Online, and Reseller channels to ensure accurate invoicing, disbursements, receipts, and payments. We are looking for an Application Reliability Engineer (ARE) to own the operational health of this platform - driving problem management, root cause resolution, and automation across a distributed, high-scale system that underpins a majority of Apple's revenue. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 You will dig into problems such as consumer/thread starvation, blocked threads, connection pool exhaustion, file watcher behavior, queue offset and retry/dead-letter behavior, stale connections, resource leaks, scheduler behavior, application state issues, dependency timeouts, and race conditions - using logs, metrics, and traces to isolate root cause across a distributed system. You will work closely with Application Engineering, Production Support, Infrastructure, and DBA teams, and communicate production trends, RCAs, and remediation plans to stakeholders across Finance, Business Operations, and Engineering.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Senior SQL Database Administrator  
**Experience:** 10–12 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad (Office / Rotational)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior SQL Database Administrator with 10–12 years of experience to lead the design, optimization, and automation of enterprise-scale database systems. This role requires deep expertise in performance tuning, large database management (10TB+), and building automation frameworks that integrate on-premises and AWS environments. The ideal candidate will adopt an “infrastructure as code” mindset and drive scalable, high-performance data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration & Maintenance**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain SQL Server databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security.
* Design and support complex replication topologies to maintain data consistency across distributed environments.
* Perform regular health checks, system audits, and capacity planning.

**Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Conduct advanced performance tuning and bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, and storage layers (NVMe/EBS) for very large databases (VLDBs).
* Perform wait state analysis and optimize storage I/O performance.

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design, implement, and manage SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Troubleshoot high-latency transactional replication issues in high-throughput systems.
* Establish and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Develop self-service automation solutions for development teams (e.g., automated database refreshes, schema validation).
* Build and maintain cross-platform automation frameworks using PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
* Implement automated compliance checks and health monitoring for large-scale environments.

**Database Migration & Upgrades**

* Architect and execute migration strategies for large databases (10TB+) from on premises to AWS (EC2/RDS) with minimal downtime. Utilize tools and techniques such as Log Shipping, Mirroring, and AWS DMS.
* Leverage Delphix for data virtualization and masking to streamline non-production data provisioning.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Deploy and manage SQL Server databases in AWS environments, including RDS and EC2.
* Ensure adherence to cloud best practices for scalability, security, and cost optimization.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Proactively monitor database performance and resolve incidents.
* Use monitoring tools such as Foglight, DataDog, CloudWatch, and Redgate.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.

**Collaboration**

* Collaborate with application development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams.
* Provide database design guidance and support development initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience as a SQL Server DBA.
* Proven experience managing large-scale databases (10TB+).
* Strong expertise in:
* SQL Server performance tuning (execution plans, indexing, query optimization)
* Always On Availability Groups
* SQL Server Replication
* Backup and recovery strategies
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Experience with Delphix (data virtualization and masking).
* Strong knowledge of AWS database services.
* Experience in database migrations and upgrades.
* Solid understanding of database security and compliance practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience with CommVault for backup and recovery.
* Working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Managed Instances).
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to translate complex technical database challenges into actionable business insights for stakeholders and provide technical mentorship to junior team members.
* Proven ability to maintain composure and lead technical resolution during high-pressure production outages and complex multi-wave cloud migrations.
* A strategic mindset focused on 'Automation First' - proactively identifying manual bottlenecks and architecting long-term scalable solutions rather than quick fixes.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role -**

We are seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented Database Administrator (DBA) with 4 - 10 years of proven hands‑on experience in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL). You will support the design, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement of mission‑critical SQL Server databases. The role requires solid skills in performance tuning, high availability, backup & recovery, and security hardening, working within a collaborative production environment and contributing to team standards and best practices. As the team expands its use of OceanBase and PostgreSQL, the ideal candidate will bring a strong willingness to learn these platforms and support migrations from SQL Server.

**The Work -**

**Database Implementation and Support**

* Install, configure, and manage the lifecycle of SQL Server instances (standalone, clustered, and Always On) across environments.
* Contribute to database architecture decisions (storage layout, file/filegroup design, instance sizing) across dev/QA/prod.
* Design and deploy schema objects (tables, views, stored procedures, functions), following standards and participating in code reviews.
* Implement and maintain configuration baselines (e.g., max server memory, MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism, TempDB layout).

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Implement and operate SQL Server HA/DR solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, and Log Shipping.
* Maintain DR runbooks and support RTO/RPO targets; participate in planned failover and disaster recovery testing.
* Monitor AG synchronization health, cluster resources, and quorum configuration; troubleshoot failover events.
* Regularly test backups and end‑to‑end recovery (database‑level, point‑in‑time, and site failover).

**Monitoring and Alerting**

* Set up proactive alerting for blocking, deadlocks, long‑running queries, failed jobs, AG latency, and disk space.
* Configure and tune monitoring for wait stats, TempDB health, I/O latency, index fragmentation, and blocking chains.
* Analyze metrics, logs, and execution plans to derive actionable insights and support incident response.

**Capacity Planning**

* Track storage, compute, and connection usage, and forecast capacity based on growth patterns and workload characteristics.
* Perform index and data growth analysis, and recommend cost‑efficient scaling approaches.

**Backup and Recovery Operations**

* Implement and automate SQL Server backup strategies (full/differential/transaction log) using native tools or Ola Hallengren maintenance solutions.
* Validate restores regularly through automated restore drills and DBCC CHECKDB integrity checks.
* Document recovery playbooks and ensure compliance with RPO/RTO objectives.

**Performance Tuning**

* Tune SQL Server workloads using execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and statistics maintenance.
* Optimize indexing strategy, mitigate parameter sniffing, and tune memory/parallelism settings; apply plan forcing when appropriate.
* Define performance baselines; guide developers on query design and access patterns.

**Security and Access Control**

* Implement least‑privilege access, role‑based security, password policies/secrets management, encryption (TDE/Always Encrypted), and auditing for SQL Server.
* Support audit/compliance requirements and periodic access reviews.

**Patching and Updates**

* Plan and execute SQL Server CU/version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
* Evaluate new SQL Server features and recommend adoption where relevant.
* Support database migrations from SQL Server to OceanBase or PostgreSQL, including schema and code conversion, data movement, cutover planning, and post‑migration validation.

**Incident Handling**

* Troubleshoot and perform root‑cause analysis for performance, availability, and data integrity incidents.
* Contribute to post‑incident reviews and implement preventative measures.

**Automation and Scripting**

* Automate routine operations using T‑SQL, PowerShell (e.g., dbatools), SQL Agent jobs, and, where applicable, Python.
* Use AI‑assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot or LLM‑based assistants) to accelerate scripting, query analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, applying sound judgment to validate outputs.
* Support version control and CI/CD practices for database code and configuration.

**Team Collaboration**

* Partner with application, platform, and infrastructure teams to align database designs with product goals.
* Review schema changes, migration scripts, and data movement; share knowledge with junior team members.

**Assist in Migrations**

* Knowledge of PostgreSQL and/or OceanBase, or experience migrating workloads from SQL Server to either platform, is an added advantage.
* Demonstrate eagerness and ability to learn new database platforms; candidates should be willing to build hands‑on skills in PostgreSQL and OceanBase.

**The Must-Haves -**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* 4-10 years of hands‑on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
* Hands‑on experience with HA/DR (Always On AG, FCI), performance tuning, and backup/recovery for business‑critical systems.

**Additional Skills (Preferred):**

* Familiarity with SSIS, SSRS, or other SQL Server BI/ETL components.
* Scripting/automation using Bash, PowerShell, or Python; CI/CD/GitOps practices.
* Practical use of AI tools for DBA work, such as AI‑assisted T‑SQL and script authoring, query and execution‑plan analysis, log/incident triage, and documentation.

**Certifications:**

* Microsoft (e.g., Azure/SQL) or equivalent (optional but preferred).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP‑300) is a plus.

**Communication:**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to document processes, participate in technical discussions, and work effectively within a team.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Client Support Engineer
description:

The primary responsibility of the Loyalty Client Support Engineer is to assist with the management and support of the technical solution for an existing large financial services client. They will act as the backbone of daily production processes and procedures; monitoring and escalating if alignment is not achieved with standard operating procedures.
  
  
The individual in this position will be support coverage for "Lights On" support, SLA Adherence, and operational monitoring while displaying a deep understanding solution standards, features, and dependent functionalities associated to the account.

**Responsibilities**  

* Ensure batch files are received and sent according to File Processing Schedule, that no large-scale errors have occurred, and escalate where needed.

* Ensuring reports are sent according to the report distribution schedule.
* Gather data for monthly SLA Reporting and present to the internal team and client.

* Create and maintain monitoring patching schedules, ensuring testing approval is received prior to production release.
* Gathering inputs around production readiness activities to ensure completion prior to technical releases.
* Leading Change Approval Board meetings internally to achieve alignment on production readiness.
* Reviewing vulnerabilities found through scanning to determine activities necessary for remediation.
* Manage documentation and requests surrounding certificates necessary to maintain day-to-day access security.
* Change scheduling and submission of necessary data required for change approval.
* Create and maintain training materials, standard operating procedures, and core system documentation.
* Configure and implement systems and programs to automate tasks and processes.
* Maintain and continuously improve production monitoring capabilities, operational dashboards, and KPI reporting to ensure platform availability, SLA adherence, proactive issue identification, and rapid incident resolution.
* Collaborate with STS, Infrastructure, Windows, and Network engineering teams to improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, address operational gaps, and maintain service availability in accordance with SLA commitments.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum of 5 years of production support experience in SLA-driven environments.

* Comfortable participating in on-call rotations and providing after-hours production support when required.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Soft Skills Required:**
  

* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies across Windows server environments and related infrastructure components, determine root cause, and drive production and project issues through to successful resolution.
* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and SQL-based troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies, determine root cause, and drive production or project issues to effective closure.
* Able to quickly develop rapport, establish credibility, and maintain trusted relationships with business, technical, global, and external partner teams.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence a wide range of stakeholders across all roles and levels.
* Contribute to effective client meetings, make proactive recommendations, and drive successful outcomes in your area of expertise.
* Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and often changing environment.
* Shows drive, initiative, and a sense of personal accountability.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, interpersonal, and time management skills.

  
**Technical Skills Required:**
  

* 5+ years supporting Windows Server in production environments, with experience across the 2016-2022 era and strong Windows Server 2022 experience preferred.
* 3+ years troubleshooting IIS-hosted applications in live production environments.
* Hands-on Windows Services, IIS administration, including sites, applications, application pools, web.config/applicationHost.config, handlers, and modules.
* Ability to diagnose common HTTP failures, including 401, 403, 500, 502, and 503 errors, and restore service under SLA.
* Experience using Failed Request Tracing (FREB), IIS/W3C logs, Windows Event Logs, and PerfMon for production diagnostics.
* Experience troubleshooting application pool issues, including recycles, rapid-fail protection, identity and permissions, and startup failures.
* Working knowledge of TLS/HTTPS bindings, certificates, SNI, and common Schannel/TLS breakages.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows Server vulnerabilities, including vulnerability assessment, patch planning, remediation validation, exception management, and coordination with infrastructure and security teams.
* Experience supporting ASP.NET Framework and/or ASP.NET Core applications on IIS, including ANCM and hosting model issues.
* PowerShell experience for remote administration, automation, and diagnostics.
* Active Directory fundamentals as they affect applications, including Kerberos/NTLM, SPNs, service accounts, and double-hop scenarios.
* Networking fundamentals for production applications, including DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies.
* Solid understanding of Relational Database Management Systems and proficiency with SQL.
* Proficient with Business Intelligence tools such as Cognos.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies and creation of defined artifacts.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise production monitoring, operational health management, KPI development, SLA measurement, trend analysis, and service reporting to ensure application availability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Proven experience collaborating with STS, Infrastructure, Windows Server, Network, and Security teams to troubleshoot production issues, improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, and support critical service availability objectives.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, service health views, and KPI reporting that support global follow-the-sun operations, enabling proactive monitoring, effective incident triage, and seamless cross-regional support handoffs.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum development is a plus.
* Understanding of consumer financial regulations is preferred.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

* Ability to capture memory dumps and use tools such as DebugDiag, ProcDump, WinDbg, or SOS to debug and diagnose application hangs, crashes, and memory-related issues.
* Experience troubleshooting ARR, URL Rewrite, and reverse-proxy configurations.
* Performance tuning experience, including queues, memory leaks, GC/thread-pool pressure, and capacity signals.
* Experience with multi-node IIS farms, NLB, or failover clustering.
* Familiarity with ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience with centralized logging and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, ELK, SCOM, or Azure Monitor agents.
* Experience configuring, administering, and leveraging enterprise monitoring and observability platforms such as OpsRamp, ThousandEyes, Sumologic and Kibana, including creating dashboards, alerts, and service health views to support proactive monitoring, incident response, and follow-the-sun global support operations.

  
**Nice-to-Have Qualifications:**
  

* Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate credentials, AZ-800/AZ-801, or equivalent Microsoft credentials.
* Experience mentoring L1/L2 support teams in a follow the sun operations support model or writing formal post-incident reviews.
* Experience with the WAF ThreatX.
* Solid understanding of Relational Database Management Systems and proficiency with SQL.
* Proficient with Business Intelligence tools such as Cognos.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies and creation of defined artifacts.
* Experience supporting ASP.NET Framework and/or ASP.NET Core applications on IIS, including ANCM and hosting model issues.

title: SAP BI/BOBJ Administration
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**SAP BI/BOBJ Administration**
Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.
  
  
**About The Team**
“Monitor production systems and respond to alerts and incidents. Perform root-cause analysis and recommend corrective actions. Document processes and maintain compliance with operational standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and implement improvements. At senior levels~ lead projects, mentor junior analysts, and influence operational strategy.
  
  
Developing individual contributor role who works independently under general supervision to support departmental goals. Responsible for achieving operational targets by adjusting or recommending improvements to systems and processes. The work involves solving problems within the job area, interpreting, and explaining information to others. Communication is primarily internal, focusing on further explanation or clarification. The colleague may influence others by sharing knowledge of policies, practices, and procedures. This position typically requires practical knowledge and demonstrated competence gained through a combination of advanced education and relevant experience.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
Provides technical and operational support for production systems. Responsibilities range from basic monitoring and troubleshooting at entry level to strategic process improvements and leadership of major initiatives at senior levels.
  
  

* Administer and maintain SAP BusinessObjects (BOBJ) and SAP BW environments
* Manage users, roles, groups, and security authorizations
* Monitor system performance, server health, and scheduled jobs
* Troubleshoot BI platform issues and coordinate with SAP Basis, DBA, and Infrastructure teams
* Perform system upgrades, patches, migrations, and refresh activities
* Support report scheduling, publication, and distribution processes
* Analyze and resolve production incidents within SLA timelines
* Monitor and maintain system availability and performance
* Create and maintain operational and technical documentation
* Participate in disaster recovery testing and business continuity activities

**Required Skills**

* 2-4 years of SAP BI/BOBJ Administration experience
* Strong knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects 4.x Administration (CMC, SIA, Auditing)
* Experience with user provisioning, security, and access management
* Knowledge of SAP BW architecture and data warehouse concepts
* Experience with Linux/Windows server environments
* Understanding of database administration concepts (Oracle, SQL Server, or HANA)
* Experience in incident, problem, and change management processes
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

**Preferred Skills**

* SAP HANA Administration exposure
* SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) knowledge
* ITIL Foundation certification
* Scripting knowledge (Shell, PowerShell, or Python)
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments.”

**What We Offer You**

* A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
* A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities – FIS is your final career step!
* A variety of career development tools, resources and opportunities

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

title: Process Lead DBA
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by
**Mr. Alan S. McKim**
, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
  
  
Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  
Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Overview:**
The District Branch Admin (DBA) team primarily responsibility to support a group of facilities as a corporate function. Oversees and manages the administrative and clerical functions of the facility operations.
  
  

* managing the administrative services provided for Technical Services group Safety-Kleen Environmental/Field Service making sure services provided on time and accurately
* You will manage a team of TSA SKE/FSA professionals, providing leadership, guidance, and support to ensure successful execution of TSA initiatives
* Provide leadership and guidance to a team of TSA SKE/FSA professionals, including hiring, training, mentoring and performance management
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of work requests from the production network through monitoring workflow and reviewing capacity, creating product level metrics, delivering feedback to requesters and team members, and training team members on new skills
* Establish and maintain relationships with business stakeholders to understand their needs
* Develop process metrics and KPIs for the team and report them out to senior leadership on regular interval
* Review effectiveness of quality control function by analysing data and managing resource quality scores
* Making sure escalations are handled effectively and dealt with CAPA framework
* Implement sustainable best practices for management, standardization, and capture of data.
* Ensure policies and procedures are documented, followed, and updated as needed
* Drive and mentor change management within TSA SKE/FSA group
* Engage with business functions and leadership to identify existing gaps in process and establish control
* Establish and drive data tracking and management mechanism within the team
* Audit the quality of TSA/ SKE/FSA associates work and share periodic constructive feedback
* Conduct regular one on one with the direct reports and prepare EWS ( Early Warning System)
* Conduct annual and semi-annual appraisals for Direct Reports

**Qualifications**

* 6-10 years of Operations experience. preferably in Accounts payable / Accounts receivables / Customer or Supplier helpdesk
* Business related Bachelors/Master’s Degree
* Experience leading and coaching teams of analysts; developing career paths and opportunities
* Excellent written and speaking communication skills; highly proactive; previous experience working with US-based leadership
* Demonstrated ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Proficiency in metrics-based decision making with an emphasis on reading and interpreting data
* Experience in remote transition
* Excellent in change management and Lean Six Sigma concept
* Excellent leadership skills and track record delivery through teams and integrating business and technology stakeholders

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description: About UsAt apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/Job DetailsThe Role -We are seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented Database Administrator (DBA) with 4 - 10 years of proven hands‑on experience in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL). You will support the design, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement of mission‑critical SQL Server databases. The role requires solid skills in performance tuning, high availability, backup & recovery, and security hardening, working within a collaborative production environment and contributing to team standards and best practices. As the team expands its use of OceanBase and PostgreSQL, the ideal candidate will bring a strong willingness to learn these platforms and support migrations from SQL Server.The Work - Database Implementation and Support Install, configure, and manage the lifecycle of SQL Server instances (standalone, clustered, and Always On) across environments. Contribute to database architecture decisions (storage layout, file/filegroup design, instance sizing) across dev/QA/prod. Design and deploy schema objects (tables, views, stored procedures, functions), following standards and participating in code reviews. Implement and maintain configuration baselines (e.g., max server memory, MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism, TempDB layout).High Availability & Disaster Recovery Implement and operate SQL Server HA/DR solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, and Log Shipping. Maintain DR runbooks and support RTO/RPO targets; participate in planned failover and disaster recovery testing. Monitor AG synchronization health, cluster resources, and quorum configuration; troubleshoot failover events. Regularly test backups and end‑to‑end recovery (database‑level, point‑in‑time, and site failover).Monitoring and Alerting Set up proactive alerting for blocking, deadlocks, long‑running queries, failed jobs, AG latency, and disk space. Configure and tune monitoring for wait stats, TempDB health, I/O latency, index fragmentation, and blocking chains. Analyze metrics, logs, and execution plans to derive actionable insights and support incident response.Capacity Planning Track storage, compute, and connection usage, and forecast capacity based on growth patterns and workload characteristics. Perform index and data growth analysis, and recommend cost‑efficient scaling approaches.Backup and Recovery Operations Implement and automate SQL Server backup strategies (full/differential/transaction log) using native tools or Ola Hallengren maintenance solutions. Validate restores regularly through automated restore drills and DBCC CHECKDB integrity checks. Document recovery playbooks and ensure compliance with RPO/RTO objectives.Performance Tuning Tune SQL Server workloads using execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and statistics maintenance. Optimize indexing strategy, mitigate parameter sniffing, and tune memory/parallelism settings; apply plan forcing when appropriate. Define performance baselines; guide developers on query design and access patterns.Security and Access Control Implement least‑privilege access, role‑based security, password policies/secrets management, encryption (TDE/Always Encrypted), and auditing for SQL Server. Support audit/compliance requirements and periodic access reviews. Patching and Updates Plan and execute SQL Server CU/version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime. Evaluate new SQL Server features and recommend adoption where relevant. Support database migrations from SQL Server to OceanBase or PostgreSQL, including schema and code conversion, data movement, cutover planning, and post‑migration validation.Incident Handling Troubleshoot and perform root‑cause analysis for performance, availability, and data integrity incidents. Contribute to post‑incident reviews and implement preventative measures. Automation and Scripting Automate routine operations using T‑SQL, PowerShell (e.g., dbatools), SQL Agent jobs, and, where applicable, Python. Use AI‑assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot or LLM‑based assistants) to accelerate scripting, query analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, applying sound judgment to validate outputs. Support version control and CI/CD practices for database code and configuration.Team Collaboration Partner with application, platform, and infrastructure teams to align database designs with product goals. Review schema changes, migration scripts, and data movement; share knowledge with junior team members.Assist in Migrations Knowledge of PostgreSQL and/or OceanBase, or experience migrating workloads from SQL Server to either platform, is an added advantage. Demonstrate eagerness and ability to learn new database platforms; candidates should be willing to build hands‑on skills in PostgreSQL and OceanBase.The Must-Haves - Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.Experience 4-10 years of hands‑on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in production environments. Hands‑on experience with HA/DR (Always On AG, FCI), performance tuning, and backup/recovery for business‑critical systems.Additional Skills (Preferred) Familiarity with SSIS, SSRS, or other SQL Server BI/ETL components. Scripting/automation using Bash, PowerShell, or Python; CI/CD/GitOps practices. Practical use of AI tools for DBA work, such as AI‑assisted T‑SQL and script authoring, query and execution‑plan analysis, log/incident triage, and documentation.Certifications Microsoft (e.g., Azure/SQL) or equivalent (optional but preferred). Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP‑300) is a plus.Communication Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to document processes, participate in technical discussions, and work effectively within a team.Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/BenefitsAt apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Data Engineering Consultant
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable data pipelines
* Develop IDM data integration solutions
* Implement data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and governance frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency of identity-related data
* Design and optimize data models, data lakes, and warehouse structures to support identity analytics, access reviews, compliance reporting, and audit requirements
* Design and implement solutions using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL, Spark, or equivalent cloud-native data platforms
* Optimize ETL/ELT processes, automate data workflows, and improve pipeline reliability, scalability, and monitoring
* Ensure data engineering solutions comply with security standards, privacy regulations, audit requirements, and enterprise IAM policies
* Work closely with IDM architects, security teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver enterprise identity data solutions
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* 7.5+ years of experience in Data Engineering
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or equivalent cloud platforms
* Hands on experience in Generative AI technologies including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Lang Chain, Agents, RAG, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, and fine-tuning
* Experience with data governance, data quality, and metadata management frameworks
* Solid SQL, Python, PySpark, and ETL/ELT development experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven excellent communication and teamwork skills
* Demonstrated great attention to detail
* Demonstrated organizational skills
* Demonstrated an analytical mind

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

description:

The COE is the primary point of contact for key customers to support their deployments and address challenging problems related to data delivery. * Proven ability to define client issues and leverage resources to solve problems.
* Other duties as assigned.

* 2-5 years of experience in Product, Operational, or Engineering roles.

* General understanding of IT infrastructure concepts (servers, databases, security, etc.) a plus.
* Basic networking troubleshooting skills a plus.
* Basic electronics troubleshooting skills a plus.
