title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Database Administrator**
to take end-to-end ownership of database reliability, availability, performance, security, backup, recovery, and operational standards across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.

This is a hands-on senior role requiring expertise in designing and building database environments from scratch, implementing high availability and disaster recovery, troubleshooting complex production issues, and establishing consistent database operations across projects.

The successful candidate will lead database architecture, implementation, monitoring, performance optimization, maintenance, production support, and continuous improvement while working closely with clients, infrastructure teams, application teams, and implementation partners.

Key Responsibilities1. SQL Server Architecture and Administration

* Design, install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain enterprise SQL Server environments across on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures.
* Build database environments from scratch, including instance configuration, storage, service accounts, security, memory, CPU, tempdb, ports, and operational jobs.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Manage availability replicas, synchronization modes, quorum, failover policies, listeners, DNS, IPs, subnets, firewall rules, and application connectivity.
* Design multi-site high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including read-only workload routing.
* Perform database health checks, configuration comparisons, controlled failovers, and DR exercises.

2. Performance Monitoring and Optimization

* Proactively identify expensive queries, blocking, deadlocks, high CPU/I/O/memory consumption, long-running transactions, and database connectivity issues.
* Use Query Store, execution plans, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, and diagnostic tools to identify root causes.
* Troubleshoot cardinality estimation, memory grants, query spills, parallelism, scans, sorts, hash operations, parameter sensitivity, and latch contention.
* Diagnose tempdb growth, transaction-log pressure, storage bottlenecks, failed jobs, and resource-capacity issues.
* Optimize queries, indexes, statistics, configuration, and resource allocation in collaboration with application and infrastructure teams.
* Establish performance baselines and capacity forecasts for CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, logs, backups, and database growth.
* Address recurring performance issues through permanent corrective actions rather than temporary workarounds such as unnecessary restarts or database shrinking.

3. Indexing, Maintenance and Partitioning

* Develop and maintain database maintenance jobs for index optimization, statistics updates, integrity checks, backups, cleanup, and reporting.
* Define workload-specific index rebuild/reorganization and statistics-update strategies.
* Analyze fragmentation, page splits, index usage, duplicate or overlapping indexes, fill factor, clustering keys, and high-DML workloads.
* Design and maintain table and index partitioning for large, high-volume databases, including partition functions, schemes, filegroups, and retention policies.
* Implement sliding-window strategies, partition switching, archival, purging, and partition-level maintenance.
* Validate partition elimination and assess the impact of maintenance and partition changes on query performance, replication, transaction logs, and availability.

4. Backup, Recovery and Disaster Recovery

* Design and implement backup and recovery strategies aligned with agreed Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs).
* Manage full, differential, transaction-log, PostgreSQL physical/logical, and other appropriate backups.
* Implement encryption, compression, retention, off-site storage, monitoring, alerting, and backup-access controls.
* Conduct regular restore and point-in-time recovery tests, validate backup integrity and transaction-log chains, and maintain recovery evidence.
* Develop documented recovery procedures for data corruption, accidental deletion, infrastructure failure, cluster failure, and site-level disasters.

5. PostgreSQL Administration

* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain PostgreSQL environments.
* Build and administer highly available clusters using streaming replication and technologies such as Patroni, etcd/Consul, repmgr, or equivalent solutions.
* Manage primary/standby nodes, replication slots, WAL, synchronous/asynchronous replication, connection routing, and failover procedures.
* Implement backup and point-in-time recovery using pgBackRest, Barman, native utilities, or approved enterprise tools.
* Monitor replication lag, connections, locks, long-running transactions, WAL growth, checkpoints, storage, table/index bloat, and database health.
* Tune PostgreSQL configuration and queries using pg\_stat\_statements, EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, logs, and wait-event analysis.
* Manage VACUUM, autovacuum, ANALYZE, REINDEX, statistics, permissions, authentication, TLS, certificates, and security hardening.
* Plan and test failovers, switchovers, recovery procedures, major-version upgrades, and rollback strategies.

6. Security, Replication and Connectivity

* Establish database security standards covering least-privilege access, role-based permissions, privileged accounts, authentication, auditing, and periodic access reviews.
* Implement encryption at rest and in transit, certificate lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, and secure credential/secret management.
* Configure and troubleshoot SQL Server transactional replication and other approved data-distribution mechanisms.
* Diagnose replication latency, agent failures, data inconsistencies, transaction-log growth, and subscriber performance.
* Troubleshoot database logins, drivers, connection strings, DNS, listeners, TLS certificates, firewall rules, and connection pooling.
* Maintain an inventory of applications, jobs, integrations, monitoring tools, reporting services, and database clients.

7. Technical Leadership and Operational Ownership

* Act as the senior database authority for clients, infrastructure teams, application teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Define reference architectures and standards for production, non-production, high-availability, and disaster-recovery environments.
* Review client and partner designs, identify technical risks, and recommend improvements across availability, security, performance, capacity, and recoverability.
* Lead technical workshops, complex production incidents, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Mentor DBAs and support teams, facilitate knowledge transfer, and ensure operational readiness before production go-live.
* Maintain architecture documents, build guides, configuration baselines, runbooks, health-check reports, recovery procedures, and incident documentation.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **10+ years**
  of database administration experience, including business-critical production systems.
* **7+ years**
  of strong, hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration experience.
* Proven experience building SQL Server environments from scratch and implementing enterprise high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of WSFC, Always On Availability Groups, listeners, quorum, multi-node failover, and multi-site architectures.
* Strong SQL Server performance-tuning expertise covering Query Store, execution plans, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, indexing, statistics, memory, parallelism, tempdb, and transaction logs.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise backup, restore, point-in-time recovery, and DR testing.
* Experience managing large, partitioned, high-DML, and high-transaction-volume databases.
* Practical PostgreSQL administration experience covering cluster setup, replication, backups, recovery, maintenance, monitoring, security, and performance tuning.
* Strong T-SQL skills, working knowledge of PostgreSQL SQL, and scripting/automation capabilities.
* Proven experience working with infrastructure, application, security, DevOps, vendor, and client teams.
* Ability to lead critical production incidents and communicate technical findings to technical and management stakeholders.
* Experience preparing architecture documents, implementation guides, operating procedures, health-check reports, and root-cause analyses.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in banking, fintech, payments, or other regulated, high-availability environments.
* Experience supporting geographically distributed production and DR sites.
* SQL Server transactional replication experience.
* Exposure to Azure SQL, SQL Server on Azure VMs, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Redgate, SolarWinds, Dynatrace, SCOM, Grafana/Prometheus, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Experience automating database builds, configuration validation, maintenance, and health checks.
* Relevant Microsoft, PostgreSQL, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.

Key Success Measures

* Database availability and reliability against agreed service targets.
* Backup success and independently verified restore capability.
* Compliance with RPO/RTO targets and successful DR/failover exercises.
* Reduction in recurring incidents, blocking, deadlocks, uncontrolled tempdb growth, and performance issues.
* Improved critical-query response times and database capacity planning.
* Healthy SQL Server Availability Groups and PostgreSQL replication.
* Timely completion of maintenance, patching, certificate renewals, recovery testing, and capacity reviews.
* Closure of database-readiness risks before production deployment.
* Consistent adoption of database standards, runbooks, and operational documentation.

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
Citi is seeking an experienced, high-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database-as-a-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi-region banking systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Enterprise Database Architecture & Technical Strategy Architect, design, and deliver end-to-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments. Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
* Modernization, DBaaS & Cloud Enablement Lead migration initiatives from legacy on-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS). Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling. Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re-platform and refactor applications for cloud-native persistence layers.
* High Availability, Replication & Scalability Engineering Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets & Sharded Clusters). Establish cross-region and multi-data-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
* Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning & Diagnostics Spearhead deep-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems. Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks. Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
* Security, Vulnerability Management & Access Control Enforce end-to-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in-transit, and privileged access controls. Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non-compliant instances across the fleet. Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub). Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation. Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
* Continuity of Business (COB) & Disaster Recovery (DR) Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills. Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point-in-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site-level disasters. Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
* Governance, Risk, Audit & Regulatory Compliance Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments. Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Vendor Engagement Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams. Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures. Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
* Required Qualifications, Experience & Certifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large-scale, enterprise financial services environment. Core Technical Competencies: In-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12+, Patroni, Connection Pooling). Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures. Demonstrated hands-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols. Certifications (Preferred): Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional Key Leadership & Soft Skills Proven track record of managing high-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. Strong ownership mindset, problem-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: Staff Database Administrator
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Database Administrator to own and evolve our SQL Server database infrastructure across production and non-production environments. This senior individual contributor role within the Infrastructure and Operations team will be responsible for database availability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and long-term architectural direction. The role will support platforms including Autotask, Kaseya VSA, and our broader multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure, while serving as the primary escalation point for critical database incidents.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the day-to-day administration, maintenance, monitoring, patching, and health of SQL Server environments across production, staging, and development.
* Drive database performance optimization through query tuning, execution plan analysis, index design, statistics management, and wait statistics analysis.
* Design, implement, and operate high-availability solutions, including SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, log shipping, and failover procedures.
* Own backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies, including point-in-time recovery, log chain management, recovery validation, and regular DR failover testing.
* Partner with application development teams to manage schema migrations and database changes while maintaining data integrity across multi-tenant environments.
* Define and own the long-term SQL Server technology roadmap, including evaluating cloud database options such as Azure SQL and AWS RDS where appropriate.
* Lead database capacity planning and forecasting across storage, IOPS, compute, and database growth requirements.
* Partner with Security, AWS Cloud, and DevOps teams on database security, access controls, encryption, monitoring, and CI/CD-based database deployments, while serving as a primary escalation point for critical database incidents and participating in the on-call rotation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6 or more years of hands-on SQL Server DBA experience in production enterprise environments, with demonstrated ownership at a senior or principal level
* Deep expertise in SQL Server performance tuning: execution plans, query rewrites, index design, statistics management, and wait type analysis
* Proven experience designing and operating SQL Server high availability solutions, specifically Always On Availability Groups
* Solid understanding of SQL Server backup and recovery architectures, including point-in-time recovery, log chain management, and DR failover testing
* Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale, including schema versioning, tenant isolation, and database-per-tenant or shared-schema architectures
* Strong scripting ability in T-SQL and PowerShell for automation of routine DBA tasks, alerting, and maintenance
* Familiarity with cloud-hosted SQL environments including Azure SQL or AWS RDS is a meaningful advantage for this role
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in written English with a distributed team across US and India time zones

title: Database Administrator
description:
**Welcome to Natus Sensory India**
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Senior Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator is responsible for the performance, availability, security, recoverability, and operational health of enterprise database platforms. This is a hands-on senior role combining system DBA responsibilities with advanced SQL performance engineering. The DBA will identify slow and inefficient workloads, analyze execution plans and wait conditions, rewrite complex queries and stored code, tune indexing and configuration, and verify measurable improvements without compromising data integrity or application behaviour.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, configure, patch, upgrade, monitor, secure, and troubleshoot production and non-production Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Review database and instance configuration, memory, CPU, storage, I/O, parallelism, TempDB or temporary tablespaces, optimizer settings, statistics, and maintenance strategies.
* Proactively identify slow, high-cost, blocking, frequently executed, or resource-intensive SQL using platform telemetry and workload history.
* Analyze Oracle execution plans, AWR/ASH reports, SQL Monitor, wait events, session activity, and optimizer behaviour; use SQL Tuning Advisor appropriately and validate recommendations.
* Analyze SQL Server actual execution plans, Query Store, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, memory grants, spills, parameter sensitivity, and plan regressions.
* Review and rewrite SQL, PL/SQL, T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, jobs, and batch processes to improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and correctness.
* Design and tune indexes, statistics, partitioning, query patterns, hints only when justified, and data-access strategies while controlling write, storage, and maintenance overhead.
* Establish repeatable performance baselines; document findings; test changes with representative data and workloads; compare duration, CPU, logical/physical I/O, waits, reads, plans, and concurrency before release.
* Own backup, restore, recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, replication, integrity checks, capacity planning, and recovery testing for both platforms.
* Support Oracle Data Guard/RMAN and SQL Server Always On, log shipping, Database Mail, SQL Agent, and native backup/restore technologies as applicable.
* Investigate incidents, blocking, deadlocks, failed jobs, corruption alerts, storage growth, capacity constraints, and database availability issues; complete root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Implement database security, encryption, auditing, least privilege, service-account controls, privileged-access practices, and compliant handling of PHI/PII.
* Automate repeatable DBA tasks using PowerShell, T-SQL, PL/SQL, SQL\*Plus/SQLcl, shell scripting, and source-controlled deployment processes.
* Partner with developers, architects, infrastructure, security, support, and vendors; provide code-review guidance and mentor other DBAs and engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior-level production DBA experience supporting both Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server in business-critical environments. Senior Oracle & SQL Server DBA
* Confidential recruiting document JOB REQUISITION | DATABASE ENGINEERING
* Expert-level SQL performance tuning and proven ability to review, rewrite, and optimize complex Oracle SQL/PL/SQL and SQL Server T-SQL.
* Deep understanding of cost-based optimization, cardinality estimation, join strategies, access paths, statistics, indexing, parameterization/bind variables, plan stability, and concurrency.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle AWR, ASH, execution plans, wait events, RMAN, Data Pump, Data Guard, and diagnostic or tuning tools.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Query Store, execution plans, DMVs, Extended Events, wait statistics, indexing, SQL Agent, backup/restore, and Always On or log shipping.
* Strong knowledge of database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, security, backup/recovery, HA/DR, monitoring, and capacity planning.
* Ability to distinguish query, schema, statistics, configuration, infrastructure, locking, application, and data volume causes of poor performance.
* Experience tuning without relying on unverified hints or indiscriminate indexing, and ability to explain the risks and tradeoffs of each recommendation.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, change-management, communication, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Eight or more years of database administration and performance-engineering experience across Oracle and SQL Server.
* Oracle Certified Professional and/or relevant Microsoft database or Azure certification.
* Experience with SQL Server 2025 and supported standard Oracle releases, including hybrid or Azure-hosted workloads.
* Experience with Azure SQL, Managed Instance, Oracle on Azure, Linux, Windows Server, SAN/storage performance, and virtualization.
* Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT, CDC, replication, large databases, partitioning, bulk loads, and high-throughput transactional systems.
* Experience in regulated healthcare or another environment subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, PHI/PII, audit, and formal change-control requirements.

**Compensation and Benefits:**
Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
**Join Natus Sensory today.**
*Confidence in every Sense.*

title: Sr Mgr Business Application
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
This is a rare opportunity to shape the architectural backbone of a global pharmaceutical leader at a moment when data and AI are redefining how medicines reach patients. As Senior Manager, you'll lead the Data Lake Operations across Teva's entire data platform — setting the direction for Databricks and Azure, designing the foundations that make AI and machine learning production-ready at scale, and establishing the data governance standards that keep it all trustworthy. You won't be executing someone else's blueprint; you'll be drawing it, working across business and technology leadership to turn a sprawling data landscape into a coherent, well-governed platform that teams actually want to build on. For a leader who wants breadth, autonomy, and visible impact — where the systems you design ultimately support better health outcomes for millions of people.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Provide end-to-end engineering support across the data lifecycle, including data acquisition, organization, analysis, and delivery.
* Design scalable architectures for new data products, platform capabilities, and data solutions.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Python, PySpark, and SQL.
* Translate business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories into secure and reliable technical solutions.
* Own data engineering initiatives from design through production deployment, applying CI/CD, security, and operational best practices.
* Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize data delivery.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Min 10+ Years Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, and data modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud data platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality practices.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with streaming and event-driven technologies, such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, and observability tools for data platforms.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL, with a good understanding of machine learning libraries.
* Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Azure DevOps.
* Solid knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience implementing automated build, testing, and deployment pipelines.
* Strong understanding of API and web-service security, data security practices, and secure data engineering methods.
* Hands-on experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL, including data modeling and query optimization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and across teams.

**Also Good to Have**
**Salary Range**
**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community.  When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.
  
  
**Already Working @Teva?**
Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development
  
  
**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. title: Principal Professional, Database Management
description:
**About Marvell**
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
  
**Your Team, Your Impact**
Corporate TechOps (Database) group is responsible for building, managing, and supporting enterprise applications, engineering databases, and associated application environments.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Plan and respond to service outages including backups and restores
* Monitor system performance and diagnose software and hardware failures to resolution
* Provide patch management and distribution capabilities to prevent new threats with minimized physical infrastructure impacts
* Provide data cleansing services, verify data integrity, and implement access controls
* Perform database configuration, monitoring, and tuning
* Provide routine maintenance including problem defect analysis and resolution, space, storage, object management, physical database layout, rollback segment management, and temporary space management
* Support logs and alerts, access rights and roles, database instance version control, new IDs, roles, authorizations, audits, locked/unlocked status, and revocation
* Perform memory usage monitoring, database parameter configuration, database resources, I/O distribution
* Ensure system health, maintenance, technical security, recovery, and basic application technical tuning
* Maintain Oracle Critical Upgrades and patch management schedules
* Supports software Development, Migration, and Integration efforts as needed
* Contribute to work plans for security analysis and recommendations.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), including 12.2.x on Oracle Database 19c
* Expertise in EBS cloning, environment refreshes, and patching, including AD/TXK, online patching (adop), RUP, and CPU/PSU
* Working knowledge of EBS application upgrades (for example, 12.1.x to 12.2.x and 12.2.x RUP upgrades), including planning, testing, cutover, and rollback
* Strong expertise in Oracle Active Data Guard (ADG) for high availability, disaster recovery, and read offloading, including switchover/failover testing
* Advanced performance tuning skills (AWR, ASH, SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning, statistics management) and support for EBS concurrent processing and workflow issues
* Experience with AWS RDS (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server), including provisioning, backup, monitoring, and failover
* Proven experience with AWS DMS for migrations and replication, including schema conversion, CDC, and data validation
* Working knowledge of MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB, including replication, clustering, and high availability
* Database security expertise, including role-based access, encryption in transit, auditing, and privileged access controls
* Experience with Okta integration (SSO/SAML/OIDC) for database-connected applications, and an understanding of Managed File Transfer (MFT) tools and related database interfaces
* Basic knowledge of AI concepts and how they can be applied to database monitoring, anomaly detection, and operational efficiency
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Shell, Python, PL/SQL). OCP and AWS Database Specialty certifications, Oracle RAC/OCI experience, and Terraform/Ansible exposure are a plus

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: Data Engineering Manager (DBA)
description:
Join us as a Data Engineering Manager (DBA) at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of location strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as a Data Engineering Manager (DBA)
**,**
you should have experience with:
  
  
****Deep Expertise In:****

* RAC, ASM
* Data Guard, GoldenGate
* RMAN backup/recovery
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
* OCI Cloud Expertise
* Hands-on experience designing and managing:
* OCI database services (DB Systems, Autonomous DB, Exadata)
* OCI Networking (VCN, DRG, Load Balancers)
* IAM and security models
* Experience with multi-region and hybrid cloud setups

**Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and lead database architecture strategy across on-prem and OCI environments
* Design high availability, disaster recovery, and multi-region architectures
* Drive cloud adoption and migration strategy (on-prem → OCI)
* Establish database standards, best practices, and governance frameworks
* OCI Cloud Leadership

****Architect And Manage:****

* OCI DB Systems (Bare Metal / VM DB)
* Autonomous Databases (ATP, ADW)
* Exadata Cloud Service (preferred)
* Lead OCI landing zone design (networking, IAM, security architecture)
* Optimize cost, performance, and scalability in OCI environments
* Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform/OCI Resource Manager

**Performance & Scalability**

* Lead advanced performance tuning and capacity planning
* Analyze AWR, ASH, ADDM reports for deep insights
* Design systems for high throughput, low latency, and scalability
* Implement partitioning, sharding, indexing, and workload management
* High Availability & DR

****Architect And Manage:****

* Oracle RAC
* Data Guard (Active Data Guard)
* GoldenGate replication
* Design zero/near-zero downtime architectures
* Conduct DR drills, failover/failback testing
* Automation & Engineering Mindset
* Drive automation-first DBA practices
* Build frameworks using:
* Shell scripting / Python
* OCI CLI / SDK
* Terraform / Ansible
* Strong scripting experience (Python, Shell)

****Expertise In:****

* Terraform / OCI Resource Manager
* CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.)
* Git-based workflows
* Integrate database deployments into CI/CD pipelines
* Introduce self-healing and auto-scaling mechanisms

**Migration & Modernization**

* Lead large-scale database migrations using:
* RMAN / Data Pump
* OCI Database Migration Service
* GoldenGate

****Modernize Legacy Databases To:****

* Autonomous DB
* Cloud-native architectures
* Security & Compliance
* Define and enforce enterprise-grade security architecture

****Implement:****

* TDE (Transparent Data Encryption)
* Data masking, auditing, and access control
* Ensure compliance with standards (e.g., GDPR, PCI-DSS where applicable)
* Other essential responsibilities:
* Act as technical authority and escalation point for complex issues
* Mentor junior DBAs and lead cross-functional teams
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, DevOps, and application teams
* Influence roadmaps and strategic decisions at leadership level
* Enterprise-level OCI database architecture blueprint
* Migration roadmap and execution plan
* Automated DBA frameworks (IaC + CI/CD)
* HA/DR design with tested failover scenarios
* Performance benchmarking and optimization reports

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Bengaluru.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
  
  
****Accountabilities****

* Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.
* Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures.
* Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

One of SAP’s strategic customers has conducted a transformation program, part of which is to consume their entire SAP landscape as enhanced private cloud model provided by SAP with more than 80 productive systems and several of the largest SAP HANA-based systems. To provide the right level of service, a dedicated team has been set up within SAP Enterprise Cloud Services to work for this strategic client. title: Data Architect

* Develop dimensional data models (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema) for reporting and business intelligence.
* Create and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, and data lineage documentation.
* Develop workforce analytics frameworks and KPI measurement models.
* Support data modernization and cloud migration projects.

* 12+ years in Data Modeling and Data Architecture.
* Strong expertise in relational database design and normalization.
* Experience with PostgreSQL , Dynamo DB, SQL Server environments.
* Experience supporting legacy modernization programs.
* Hands-on experience with AWS-based enterprise platforms.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Data Modeling tools: ERwin, ER/Studio, PowerDesigner or equivalent.

* Metadata management and data lineage practices.

title: Mainframe DB2 CDC Database Administrator

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

In this role, you will play a key part in administering and supporting Mainframe DB2 and CDC environments, managing database operations, configuring and maintaining CDC replication solutions, ensuring data integrity, optimizing system performance, troubleshooting replication issues, and supporting high-availability data replication across enterprise platforms.
  
  
**What you will Do**

  

* Administer and support IBM Db2 for z/OS databases in a large-scale mainframe environment.
* Configure, monitor, and maintain CDC (Change Data Capture) replication solutions to enable real-time data movement across platforms.
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and availability throughout replication and database operations.
* Monitor and optimize Db2 and CDC performance, identifying and resolving system bottlenecks and replication latency issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve database, replication, and connectivity incidents to meet service level objectives.
* Perform database maintenance activities, including backup, recovery, migration, upgrades, and patch management.
Support high availability and disaster recovery strategies for mission-critical Db2 environments.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of experience in administering and supporting Mainframe z/OS, IBM DB2, and IMS databases, including database structure administration, utility management, performance optimization, and database maintenance activities across enterprise environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot IMS and DB2 batch job failures, ensuring timely resolution and root cause identification.
* Perform DB2 and IMS structure backfill, database refreshes, and recovery activities across non-production and production environments.
* Execute tablespace and index reorganizations, space reclamation, performance tuning, and capacity management initiatives.
* Review and optimize SQL queries and access paths, improving database performance and reducing resource consumption.
* Create and manage change tickets, supporting end-to-end implementation from development through production deployment.
* Monitor DB2/IMS health check jobs, tablespace status, database objects, and perform object alterations using DB2 commands as required.
Support IMS administration activities including DBD changes, ACBGEN, DELGEN, AUTOGEN, DBRC registration, backup/recovery, reporting, documentation, and knowledge transfer initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in MF DB2 CDC Database Administration with expertise in IBM IIDR/Change Data Capture (CDC), replication monitoring, subscription management, and troubleshooting replication issues.
* Hands-on experience in monitoring and maintaining CDA subscriptions, performing subscription refreshes, schema modifications, and ensuring seamless data synchronization between source and target databases.
* Proficient in creating replication SQLs for DB2 tables, managing TOAD Oracle environments, and developing IMS structural queries for Kafka-based data replication.
* Strong Enterprise Linux administration skills with proven ability to create and maintain technical documentation for installations, upgrades, operational procedures, and support processes.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to logically diagnose and resolve complex replication and database-related issues.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 who brings strong reporting and data experience to design, build, and optimize scalable systems that power analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities for clients. You work as a senior technical contributor, helping shape architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices across the team. You use sound judgment, deep technical expertise, and a data-driven mindset to build secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that support business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design resilient, secure distributed systems at scale from initial concept through implementation.
* Lead technical decisions that raise the engineering bar for scalability, resiliency, security, and overall engineering excellence.
* Discover, review, and influence evolving designs, architecture, and standards for building and delivering services and solutions.
* Investigate, design, and implement innovative technologies that expand infrastructure capabilities through robust, scalable solutions.
* Develop and execute designs for complex systems using strong engineering analysis, testing, and optimization.
* Create, gather, and use metrics to manage server fleets and complex computing systems, driving automation, performance improvements, and operational efficiency.
* Own detailed design, analysis, testing, and optimization to ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and high performing.
* Mentor and onboard new team members to support effective ramp-up and ongoing team success.
* Collaborate with engineers, internal services across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements and maintain a tight, data-driven feedback loop.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and respond within defined SLAs.

**What You'll Need**

* Minimum 5+ years of related professional experience; prior software engineering experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong programming skills in object-oriented programming languages, including .NET and C#, with experience in RESTful API development and EF Core mapping.
* Proficiency with Angular and TypeScript.
* Experience working with SQL, RDS, and DynamoDB.
* Solid understanding of software and database design patterns.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, and availability.
* Experience with cloud-native AWS managed services, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.
* Experience working with OAuth2, JWT, and Secrets Manager.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly learning new technologies, expanding technical scope, and applying new knowledge to improve systems and team outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by influencing technical direction, collaborating effectively across engineering and partner teams, mentoring others, and working through differing viewpoints constructively.
* Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting priorities and technical approaches in response to changing requirements, evolving architecture, and operational demands while staying focused on outcomes.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to solve infrastructure, reporting, and scalability challenges that create business value.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by using metrics, data, and sound engineering logic to evaluate tradeoffs, solve complex problems, and support technical decisions.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

**Work Environment**

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*
*To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this*
*link*
*To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this*
*link*
*Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).*

Our fulfillment centers handle more individual items than any company in the world, combining computer vision, mobile robots, advanced end-of-arm tooling, and high-degree of freedom movement with state-of-the-art AI. * 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
* 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift

title: IT ERP Product Analyst III
description:
Work Model: You’ll work in a hybrid model, onsite at your designated Regal Rexnord location, with flexibility to work remotely.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Position Summary**
The IT ERP Product Analyst III is responsible to design and deliver solutions to fulfill requirements of Regal’s supply chain business. The individual should possess comprehensive techno-functional competencies in Supply Chain (INV, BOM, WIP, Costing, and PO) modules of Oracle EBS and working knowledge of Advanced Supply Chain Planning (ASCP), Demantra and Inventory Optimization (IO) modules of Oracle VCP. The person is responsible to deliver on-time and first-time-right for complex projects and kaizen events, to resolve production incidents within SLAs, to conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence or problems, to monitor and improve system performance and reliability on continuous basis and to coach team members as necessary. Gathers and analyzes requirements, designs, develops and tests enhancements, extensions and integrations (RICEW / CEMLI) for existing Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP modules. Maintains technical documentation (BR100s, MD50s/70s, CV40s/70s, etc). Assists in defining, reviewing and maintaining standards. Liaises and coordinates with business and IT stakeholders including offshore team members. Participates in formulating and defining scope of Oracle EBS / VCP projects and own delivery of several components.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Gather and analyze business requirements; design, develop, test and implement technical solutions to fulfill requirements of supply chain, manufacturing, and planning areas; and provide post implementation maintenance and support
* Document system specifications (SSDs - high level) (MD50s), detailed design (DDDs) (MD70s), Unit Test Plan, Deployment Notes (MD120s), etc. using Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology).
* Support System Functional testing, End-To-End Integration testing, Regression testing, and User Acceptance testing within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate among onsite and offshore members of Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP technical developers to design, build, unit test and support solutions that are on-time, first-time-right and within budget.
* Ensure compliance to Release management, Change management and configuration management processes.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, and Extensions (including workflows) to enhance existing Oracle EBS / VCP solutions and integrate it with other applications.
* Respond, analyze and resolve production incidents within SLAs, perform routine maintenance tasks, and monitor / enhance performance of scheduled programs to ensure business continuity.
* Automate and maintain Integration of Oracle EBS / VCP modules with other internal and external systems.
* Participate in following activities:
* Analyze and plan Oracle EBS / VCP upgrades (i.e. Family Packs)
* Create and resolve service requests in collaboration with ‘My Oracle Support’
* Provide production support as per Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Continuously improve system performance and reliability by identifying opportunities for root cause analysis and automation
* Facilitate in establishing standards and Best Practices for software design, development and Unit Test and lead team to leverage these standards and best practices to deliver high quality and cost effective solutions.
* Use systematic techniques and process modeling tools for effective system specifications and design - like Use-case scenarios, Activity Diagrams, Data-flow Diagramming etc.

**Required Education / Experience / Skills**

* Educations:
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience
* Experience
* 10+ years of experience building and supporting solutions based on Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP R12 (Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Inventory Optimization) in global environment – with at least 2or 3 full lifecycle implementations or 3+ years of monitoring, maintaining, enhancing, integrating and upgrading
* Awareness or Green Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma or APICS (CPIM, CIRM) certification preferred
* Technical Skills:
* Highly skilled in Oracle E-Business Suite's APIs, Open Interfaces structure, EBS / VCP data models, building RICEW (Report, Interface, Conversion, Extension, Workflow) or CEMLI (Configuration, Extension, Modification, Localization, and Integration) objects, Forms, Form Personalization, XML Publisher, OA Framework, SQL, PL/SQL (Stored procedures, packages and triggers), Bulk processing, ETL operations, REF cursors, collections, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge in collection methods, plan parameters, Demantra and Inventory Optimization architecture
* Ability to analyze and resolve supply-demand exceptions and issues as per SLAs
* Experience with SQL\*Plus, SQL\*Loader, Data Loader, Export/Import, TKPROF, Oracle scheduler, Advanced Queues, Object management
* Proficient in tools like TOAD, PL/SQL Developer, Data Modeling tools, Version Control tools.
* UNIX shell scripting experience (desired)
* Conversant with Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology)
* Professional Certification(s) like Supply Chain industry or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 (strongly desired)
* Working experience in Oracle EBS R12 Supply Chain (Discrete Manufacturing) modules (strong desired)

**Travel:**
25% of time – mostly during project milestones, kaizen or similar events
  
  
**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
  
  
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
  
  
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
We are seeking a
**Sr Business Intelligence Engineer**
to join our Intelligence team. In this role, you will drive the development and optimization of our analytical infrastructure, enabling efficient, scalable, and consistent reporting and analytics across the organization. You will play a critical role in shaping the foundation of our BI ecosystem—working at the intersection of engineering, data modeling, and stakeholder enablement.
  
  
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced BI engineer who can execute cross-functional projects, design performant data models, and contribute to the execution of a unified data strategy across platforms. You will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members and contribute to the evolution of Cohere’s modern data stack and governance practices.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the execution and refinement of our business intelligence and analytics architecture, ensuring consistency, performance, and scalability across dashboards and self-service tools.
* Design and implement robust semantic and dimensional data models supporting operational, clinical, and strategic analytics use cases.
* Collaborate closely with data platform, analytics, and product teams to define shared data definitions, build source-of-truth datasets, and align transformations with stakeholder needs.
* Improve data pipeline efficiency and maintainability by establishing and enforcing best practices in dbt modeling, testing, and documentation.
* Support release management, quality testing, version control, and promotion of analytics assets across environments.
* Enable data providers and analysts to deliver high-impact dashboards and KPI frameworks using Tableau, with an emphasis on performance, usability, and governance.
* Serve as the primary Tableau Cloud SME for the organization, including user management, security, performance tuning, and environment configuration.
* Lead integration of Tableau dashboards into front-end web applications using the Tableau APIs (embedding, authentication, filtering, and automation).
* Identify and remediate performance bottlenecks across queries, data models, and dashboards to ensure efficient access to high-volume datasets.
* Drive adoption of scalable, governed data marts that balance self-service enablement with data integrity, security, and compliance.
* Mentor and functionally lead junior engineers and analysts by providing technical guidance, conducting design reviews, and reinforcing BI and data engineering best practices.
* Contribute to shared documentation, standards, and operating processes to ensure long-term sustainability and trust in our analytics ecosystem.

I
**SMS roles and responsibilities**

* Fair understanding of Information Security practices.
* Align to the organization policies and procedures.
* Ensure to get updated with ISMS roles as assigned by the department/process heads.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, or data engineering, preferably in healthcare or another data-rich, regulated domain.
* Expert-level proficiency in SQL and strong hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics engineering frameworks (e.g., dbt or similar).
* Extensive experience working with healthcare data domains such as claims, members, providers, eligibility, authorizations, or utilization management.
* Deep expertise in Tableau (Cloud, Desktop, Prep), including Tableau APIs, dashboard embedding, row-level security, performance optimization, and administration.
* Proven experience designing scalable data models that support both enterprise reporting and ad hoc analysis.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling principles, normalization vs. denormalization tradeoffs, and analytical performance tuning.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Hands-on experience working in AWS-based data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or functionally lead a small team, providing technical direction and enforcing standards.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical decisions into business value.

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with the TAP for a Preliminary Phone Screening
* Meet with your Hiring Manager
* Technical Deep Dive
* Case Study
* Interview with Senior Leadership
* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health**
Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.
  
  
With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.
  
  
Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition. We’ve been recognized on TIME’s World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024.
