title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Manages the activities of a team of data analysts and newer data engineers responsible for developing software code that formats, tags, processes, stores and serves data. Manages the development of data pipelines to ensure that they are scalable, repeatable, and secure and can serve multiple groups at Vanguard.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, Data Engineering is responsible for leading a team of data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role focuses on enabling high-performance data workflows, ensuring seamless data integration and driving automation to enhance data accessibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Define and execute data engineering strategy, architecture, and roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise data objectives.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integration frameworks, and cloud-native data platforms.
* Drive the development of data warehouses, lakehouse solutions, data products, and analytical platforms that support enterprise reporting and insights.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Partner with data science, analytics, product, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions.
* Ensure data platforms are secure, resilient, performant, and compliant with enterprise technology standards.
* Champion automation, DevOps practices, and modern engineering methodologies to improve delivery efficiency and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership for evaluating and adopting emerging technologies and data engineering best practices.
* Manage delivery planning, stakeholder communications, risk management, and execution of strategic data initiatives.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing data engineering teams and large-scale data infrastructure.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT, or a related field or Diploma in Data Science/Data Engineering.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data products.
* Strong expertise in ETL/ELT development, data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka, and modern data engineering frameworks.
* Experience building cloud-native data solutions utilizing AWS and Databricks technologies.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security, and operational monitoring.
* Experience working within Agile delivery models and leading cross-functional technology teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services including S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Athena, and Redshift.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Knowledge of Data Mesh, Data Products, Semantic Modeling, and Metadata Management.
* Experience with business intelligence and analytics platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Exposure to AI-enabled data platforms and Agentic AI solutions.
* Financial services or other regulated industry experience.
* Experience leading enterprise data transformation initiatives and globally distributed engineering teams

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.
  
  
This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.
  
  
To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer’s business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.
  
  
**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it’s Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.
  
  
Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*
SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses.

*California Recruitment Privacy Notice*
*. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our*
*EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.*

**What You’ll Do**
Manage demand intake and feasibility, working with project, testing and application teams to clarify scope, data conditions, environments, timelines, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Perform data analysis and discovery, analysing schemas, relationships, business rules and data patterns to translate functional scenarios into precise test-data selection or creation logic.
  
  
Deliver test-data provisioning by extracting, subsetting, refreshing, cloning, masking or generating data using approved TDM platforms and scripts while preserving referential integrity and usability.
  
  
Develop automation and reusable capabilities, including repeatable workflows, utilities, templates and self-service solutions that reduce manual effort and improve turnaround times.
  
  
Manage requests through agreed ticketing processes, maintaining appropriate evidence, status updates, blockers and closure information while meeting service levels.
  
  
Write and optimise SQL for data analysis, extraction, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
  
  
Coordinate with DBAs, environment teams, application owners, security teams and testers to resolve dependencies.
  
  
Support incident analysis and root-cause investigation for data defects, failed jobs and environment issues.
  
  
Contribute to Agile delivery through sprint execution, backlog refinement and collaboration within Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environments.
  
  
Support API integration and partner onboarding and testing activities, including reusable integration documentation, data mappings and technical artefacts.

You have practical TDM engineering knowledge covering data discovery, subsetting, masking, synthetic data generation, refresh, cloning and referential integrity.

Risk and business-impact assessment.

Software Quality Engineer with expertise in distributed systems with 5-8 years of IT experience. * Design, build, and maintain stable test environments

* Define environment strategy (INT, UAT)

* Perform root cause analysis for failures

**Test Data Management & Setup**

* Define test data strategy and sourcing approaches
* Execute test data provisioning and refresh cycles
* Perform data validation and reconciliation using SQL
* Ensure end-to-end data traceability
* Support CI/CD pipelines with automated data setup

**Data Masking & Compliance**

* Ensure data privacy compliance in non-PROD environments
* Implement data masking using Delphix
* Define masking rules for sensitive data
* Support audit and regulatory compliance

* 5 to 8 years of experience; education and experience may be combined to satisfy experience requirements.

* Strong knowledge of complex SQL and optimization techniques.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.
  
  
Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization
  
  

* Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
* Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
* Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
* Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
* Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
* Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation
  
  

* Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
* Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
* Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
* Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
* Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
* Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
* Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development
  
  

* Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
* Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
* Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
* Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
* Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization
  
  

* Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
* Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)
* Work hands-on with MDM, Snowflake, and related systems to implement quality controls
* Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape
* Build automated data validation checks within integration pipelines

Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Gathering
  
  

* Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
* Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
* Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
* Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
* Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
* Support the long-term data quality roadmap
* Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

**Required Qualifications Experience**

* 8+ years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields, preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
* 5+ years hands-on experience with at least one data quality platform (e.g., Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, Talend Data Quality, or similar)
* 5+ years advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
* 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
* 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
* 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
* 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
* 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
* Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
* Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
* Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
* Comfortable working across global teams and time zones

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures for data quality changes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ataccama Experience: Hands-on experience with Ataccama ONE platform (DQ rules, profiling, monitoring, workflows)
* Multi-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains

title: Senior System Administrator - Windchill
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
The Senior System Administrator is responsible for defining, administering, and maintaining the hardware, software, and environments for PLM, Regulatory, R&D and Clinical systems required to support Edwards’ business transformation from development through production. This role collaborates with Architects and Application Owners to create and manage system environments, supports administration and maintenance, defines release management, source code control, build and deployment procedures, and ensures environments are available, secure, compliant, and performing as expected. The role works closely with cross-functional IT, Infrastructure, Compliance, Configuration, Development, vendor, and business teams to maintain system availability, support upgrades, execute deployments, manage backups and disaster recovery planning, and maintain infrastructure-related validation documentation.
  
  
**How will you make an impact:**

* Administer, install, update, optimize, debug, and maintain PTC Windchill applications and related system environments across development, test, certification, and production.
* Lead and Manage application administration activities across the lifecycle, including vendor coordination, installation, data import, upgrades, user issue resolution, permissions and roles, backups, automation, and application retirement.
* Define, maintain, and execute source code management, release management, deployment, and configuration management work instructions to support Configuration and Development teams.
* Build releases, including weekly, on-demand, and snapshot releases for local instances, and support code deployments, configuration changes, code review, and test coordination.
* Plan, configure, document, and support high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, and environment readiness requirements.
* Provide guidance on non-functional requirements, including performance, load testing, benchmarking, scalability, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Perform Windchill system maintenance activities, including upgrades, patches, security vulnerability remediation, new release installation, daily and weekly maintenance plans, WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, and environment refresh or rehosting.
* Maintain Windchill vault space, administer CAD and Office workers, perform log and temporary file cleanup and rotation, and support remote file server setup and maintenance.
* Review Server Manager, Method Server, and other Windchill logs for issues; administer, monitor, and report through PTC System Monitor.
* Write and maintain deployment scripts, coordinate environment resources and schedules, monitor CPU, RAM, and disk space growth, and plan for expansion or cleanup as needed.
* Lead and Perform issue resolution, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to strengthen system stability and reduce recurring issues.
* Support coordinated patching, hotfix, and vulnerability remediation activities for Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platforms across OS, application, and database layers, partnering with IT Database and Infrastructure teams to strengthen compliance, stability, and risk mitigation.
* Author and maintain system administration, infrastructure, validation, work instruction, deployment, and environment maintenance documentation to support compliance and audit readiness.
* Provide on-call critical support and partner with Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts, application users, vendors, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and maintain service levels.
* Lead and mentor junior/new team members by providing technical guidance, ensuring adherence to support processes, and driving the creation and maintenance of high-quality technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**What you'll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related IT discipline.
* 5–7 years of related working experience in PTC Windchill v12.0.1 or above system administration.
* 5–7 years of IT experience demonstrating solid performance while working with cross-functional IT and business teams on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Hands-on experience administering Windchill environments across development, test, certification, and production, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Experience with Windchill maintenance and administration activities such as WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, vault space management, CAD and Office worker administration, remote file server maintenance, and log review.
* Experience supporting source code management, release management, build and deployment procedures, deployment scripting, environment refreshes, and configuration changes.
* Experience supporting high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, performance, load testing, and system monitoring requirements.
* Experience supporting Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platform patching or hotfix activities across OS, application, and database layers, including coordination with IT Database and Infrastructure teams on implementation, vulnerability remediation, compliance, stability, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, detail-oriented, organizational, and information-seeking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal relationship skills, and ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience working in multi-workstream development environments using DevOps CI/CD tools and methodologies, with working knowledge of JIRA and GitLab.
* Experience in Codebeamer administration, configuration, workflow management, or integration with enterprise engineering and ALM processes.
* Technical skills in Java, JSP, JavaScript, XML, JSON, SQL, PL/SQL, SOAP, RESTful Web Services, Python, and relevant code development languages and concepts.
* Experience with enterprise application and platform administration across Windows Server, IIS Web Server, Apache Tomcat, RHEL/Linux administration, Microsoft .NET, SSL certificate management, load balancers, routing, firewall concepts, access control, networking, and communication protocols.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL queries, Oracle APEX administration, Oracle DB 19c, SOLR or search engine indexing concepts, Aras PLM, SAS Administration, AWS servers, and patch management.
* Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, highly regulated, or corporate enterprise environments.
* Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and work toward long-term goals.
* Strong relationship management, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives across teams.
* Substantial knowledge and understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Strict attention to detail and ability to work independently in a complex enterprise support environment.

We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations
  
  

* Architectural Leadership: Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for the data migration engine and its surrounding ecosystem. Contribute core, foundational code that solves the hardest scalability problems and sets the standard for the rest of the team
* Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Design to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives
* Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

Success Measures
  
  
Within the first three months, you will have:
  
  

* Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
* Familiarise yourself with the problem space and the domain
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews

Within six months, you will have:
  
  

* Worked on and delivered a large-scale code analysis feature in the product
* Contributed to and helped deliver a few releases of the product
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered large-scale features across our entire tech stack
* Helped recruit, interview and mentor new members of the team
* Collaborated with other teams at MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

* Experience supporting global Salesforce environments.
* Exposure to basic integrations and API concepts.
* Experience working in consulting or managed services environments.

* A strong Salesforce Administrator with a consulting mindset
* Confident communicating with senior US business stakeholders

* Capable of recommending solutions rather than simply executing tasks

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: Microsoft-CRM technical-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.
* Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
* Build custom solutions using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.
* Design and implement scalable integrations using Azure and Power Platform capabilities.
* Oversee system architecture, performance tuning, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment to ensure optimal functionality and user experience.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, fostering collaboration and high-quality delivery.
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and actionable discussions.
* Participate in project planning, sprint ceremonies, estimations, and delivery governance using Agile methodologies.
* Stay current with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform advancements, recommending continuous improvements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
  
  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Oracle Cloud Solution and Technology Architect – Senior Manager**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Cloud Solution & Technology Architect (Senior Manager) to lead the enterprise-wide architecture, design, governance, and delivery of Oracle Cloud solutions across Applications (ERP, HCM, SCM, CX, EPM), Technology (OCI, PaaS), Integrations, security domains. and a strong understanding of enterprise business processes. This role requires strategic leadership, collaboration with senior stakeholders, technical teams, and end-users to drive successful enterprise-wide Oracle application deployments.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Own and lead the end‑to‑end architecture across Oracle Cloud Applications and Technology platforms.
* Develop and maintain target‑state architecture, reference architectures, and roadmaps.
* Govern architectural decisions through ADRs, design reviews, and standards.
* Lead multi‑pillar solution architecture across ERP, HCM, SCM, EPM, CX and establish common security, workflow, data, and integration frameworks
* Define and oversee data migration strategies and integrations with third-party applications using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and middleware solutions.
* Architect solutions using OCI networking, IAM, compute, OKE, Functions, API Gateway, Autonomous DB, etc.
* Establish enterprise integration strategy using OIC, APIs, events, and canonical models.
* Govern data models, MDM alignment, and data migration and design hybrid-cloud and coexistence strategies with HA/DR.
* Establish cloud security architecture covering IAM, encryption, audit and ensure compliance with regulatory standards
* Partner with C-suite executives, business leaders, IT teams, and external vendors to align technology strategies with business goals.
* Stay current with OCI and Oracle Cloud releases, AI/ML, GenAI, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation

**Experience**
:
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 7 years in Oracle Cloud solutions.
* Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Oracle Alloy and Oracle Dedicated Region environments.
* Expertise in architecting hybrid multi cloud ecosystems spanning on premises, colocation facilities, and multiple public cloud providers.
* Strong understanding of data residency, data sovereignty, and regulatory compliance requirements across MENA or global regions.
* Hands on experience implementing and governing Cloud Marketplace and Service Catalog capabilities.
* Industry experience across Telecommunications, Energy, and Government & Infrastructure (G&I) sectors.
* Expertise in one or more of the Oracle application modules: ERP, HCM, SCM, or CX preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle PaaS, and middleware solutions.
* Hands-on experience with data migration, API-based integrations, and security configurations.
* Deep understanding of enterprise business processes in finance, HR, supply chain, or customer experience domains.
* Experience leading multi-country, multi-currency, and global Oracle application implementations.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Oracle Cloud certifications (preferred).

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Experience in Agile methodologies and DevOps for Oracle Cloud implementations.
* Knowledge of emerging technologies such as AI, ML, and Blockchain in enterprise applications.
* Prior experience in industries such as manufacturing, retail, banking, or healthcare
* Strong project planning, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to manage complex projects with priorities while meeting deadlines and budgets.
* Advanced analytical thinking, with a focus on integrating data-driven insights and predictive models into financial planning processes.
* Experience in diagnosing and solving technical and process challenges efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex concepts to diverse audiences.
* Strong relationship-building skills to foster trust and credibility with clients and internal teams.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies, including Oracle Cloud updates and AI-driven solutions.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, learning, and innovation in enterprise performance management.
* Must possess a valid passport and be willing to travel for client site work (domestic and international)

**Education**
:
  
  

* Graduate from a reputed educational institution; MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Oracle Cloud (SaaS + OCI), TOGAF, PMP, Agile certifications preferred

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
